q.en: In copywriting, what does the AIDA formula stand for?
q.hi: Copywriting mein AIDA formula ka full form kya hai?
q.mr: Copywriting मध्ये AIDA formula चे पूर्ण रूप काय आहे?

en: Attention, Interest, Desire, Action
Awareness, Insight, Demand, Approval
Audience, Idea, Design, Advertising
Attract, Inform, Deliver, Analyse
hi: Attention, Interest, Desire, Action
Awareness, Insight, Demand, Approval
Audience, Idea, Design, Advertising
Attract, Inform, Deliver, Analyse
mr: Attention, Interest, Desire, Action
Awareness, Insight, Demand, Approval
Audience, Idea, Design, Advertising
Attract, Inform, Deliver, Analyse

exp.en: AIDA = Attention, Interest, Desire, Action. Good copy first grabs attention, builds interest, creates desire and then asks for a clear action.
exp.hi: AIDA = Attention, Interest, Desire, Action. Achhi copy pehle attention pakadti hai, interest banati hai, desire create karti hai aur phir clear action maangti hai.
exp.mr: AIDA = Attention, Interest, Desire, Action. चांगली copy आधी लक्ष वेधते, interest वाढवते, desire निर्माण करते आणि मग स्पष्ट action मागते.

q.en: In the marketing funnel, what does TOFU stand for?
q.hi: Marketing funnel mein TOFU ka matlab kya hai?
q.mr: Marketing funnel मध्ये TOFU म्हणजे काय?

en: Total Online Followers Update
Time Of First Usage
Top Of the Funnel
Target Offer For Users
hi: Total Online Followers Update
Time Of First Usage
Top Of the Funnel
Target Offer For Users
mr: Total Online Followers Update
Time Of First Usage
Top Of the Funnel
Target Offer For Users

exp.en: TOFU = Top Of the Funnel, the awareness stage where people first discover you. MOFU is the middle (consideration) and BOFU the bottom (decision).
exp.hi: TOFU = Top Of the Funnel, yaani awareness stage jahan log aapko pehli baar discover karte hain. MOFU middle (consideration) aur BOFU bottom (decision) stage hai.
exp.mr: TOFU = Top Of the Funnel, म्हणजे awareness टप्पा जिथे लोक तुम्हाला पहिल्यांदा ओळखतात. MOFU मधला (consideration) आणि BOFU शेवटचा (decision) टप्पा आहे.

q.en: What is a 'buyer persona'?
q.hi: 'Buyer persona' kya hota hai?
q.mr: 'Buyer persona' म्हणजे काय?

en: A list of all customers who bought last month
A research-based profile of your ideal customer
The brand ambassador who appears in your ads
A customer's login account on your website
hi: Pichhle mahine kharidne wale sab customers ki list
Research par based aapke ideal customer ka profile
Aapke ads mein aane wala brand ambassador
Website par customer ka login account
mr: मागच्या महिन्यात खरेदी केलेल्या सर्व ग्राहकांची यादी
Research वर आधारित तुमच्या आदर्श ग्राहकाचे profile
तुमच्या ads मध्ये दिसणारा brand ambassador
वेबसाइटवरील ग्राहकाचे login account

exp.en: A buyer persona is a semi-fictional profile of your ideal customer (goals, problems, habits) built from real research. It helps you write content that speaks to real needs.
exp.hi: Buyer persona aapke ideal customer ka semi-fictional profile hai (goals, problems, habits), jo real research se banta hai. Isse content real needs ke hisaab se likha ja sakta hai.
exp.mr: Buyer persona म्हणजे खऱ्या research वर आधारित तुमच्या आदर्श ग्राहकाचे अर्ध-काल्पनिक profile (goals, समस्या, सवयी). त्यामुळे content ग्राहकाच्या खऱ्या गरजांनुसार लिहिता येते.

q.en: What does CRM stand for?
q.hi: CRM ka full form kya hai?
q.mr: CRM चे पूर्ण रूप काय आहे?

en: Content Reach Metric
Campaign Revenue Model
Customer Response Message
Customer Relationship Management
hi: Content Reach Metric
Campaign Revenue Model
Customer Response Message
Customer Relationship Management
mr: Content Reach Metric
Campaign Revenue Model
Customer Response Message
Customer Relationship Management

exp.en: CRM = Customer Relationship Management: the process and software (like HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Salesforce) used to track leads, customers and every interaction with them.
exp.hi: CRM = Customer Relationship Management: leads, customers aur unke saath har interaction track karne ka process aur software (jaise HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Salesforce).
exp.mr: CRM = Customer Relationship Management: leads, ग्राहक आणि त्यांच्याशी झालेला प्रत्येक संवाद track करण्याची पद्धत आणि software (उदा. HubSpot, Zoho CRM, Salesforce).

q.en: What is a 'lead magnet'?
q.hi: 'Lead magnet' kya hota hai?
q.mr: 'Lead magnet' म्हणजे काय?

en: A free, useful offer given in exchange for contact details
A paid ad that shows only to existing customers
A tool that removes fake leads from your CRM
A discount given after the third purchase
hi: Contact details ke badle diya jaane wala free, useful offer
Sirf existing customers ko dikhne wala paid ad
CRM se fake leads hatane wala tool
Teesri purchase ke baad milne wala discount
mr: Contact details च्या बदल्यात दिलेली मोफत, उपयुक्त ऑफर
फक्त existing ग्राहकांना दिसणारी paid ad
CRM मधून fake leads काढणारे tool
तिसऱ्या खरेदीनंतर मिळणारी सवलत

exp.en: A lead magnet is something valuable offered free (e-book, checklist, free class, sample) in exchange for an email or phone number, so you can keep marketing to that person.
exp.hi: Lead magnet ek valuable free cheez hai (e-book, checklist, free class, sample) jo email ya phone number ke badle di jaati hai, taaki aap us person ko aage market kar sako.
exp.mr: Lead magnet म्हणजे email किंवा phone number च्या बदल्यात दिलेली मोफत उपयुक्त गोष्ट (e-book, checklist, free class, sample), ज्यामुळे त्या व्यक्तीपर्यंत पुढे marketing करता येते.

q.en: Why must marketing emails include an 'unsubscribe' link?
q.hi: Marketing emails mein 'unsubscribe' link kyun zaroori hai?
q.mr: Marketing emails मध्ये 'unsubscribe' link का आवश्यक असते?

en: To track how many people opened the email
To let the brand add more people to the list
To let recipients easily stop getting marketing emails
To make the email load faster on mobile
hi: Kitne logon ne email open kiya yeh track karne ke liye
Brand list mein aur log add kar sake isliye
Taaki receiver aasani se marketing emails band kar sake
Mobile par email jaldi load ho isliye
mr: किती लोकांनी email उघडला हे track करण्यासाठी
Brand ला list मध्ये आणखी लोक जोडता यावेत म्हणून
प्राप्तकर्त्याला marketing emails सहज बंद करता यावेत म्हणून
Mobile वर email लवकर load व्हावा म्हणून

exp.en: Laws like the US CAN-SPAM Act and major inbox providers require a clear way to opt out. Hiding it makes people hit 'Report spam' instead, which hurts deliverability.
exp.hi: US ka CAN-SPAM Act jaise laws aur bade inbox providers clear opt-out maangte hain. Link chhupaoge toh log 'Report spam' dabayenge, jisse deliverability kharab hoti hai.
exp.mr: US चा CAN-SPAM Act सारखे कायदे आणि मोठे inbox providers स्पष्ट opt-out मागतात. Link लपवला तर लोक 'Report spam' दाबतात आणि deliverability खराब होते.

q.en: In marketing, what does 'PR' usually stand for?
q.hi: Marketing mein 'PR' ka matlab usually kya hota hai?
q.mr: Marketing मध्ये 'PR' चा अर्थ सहसा काय असतो?

en: Paid Reach
Public Relations
Product Review
Page Rank
hi: Paid Reach
Public Relations
Product Review
Page Rank
mr: Paid Reach
Public Relations
Product Review
Page Rank

exp.en: PR = Public Relations: managing a brand's reputation and relationships with media and the public, often earning free (earned) coverage rather than paying for ads.
exp.hi: PR = Public Relations: media aur public ke saath brand ki reputation aur relations manage karna, aksar ads ke paise diye bina earned (free) coverage paana.
exp.mr: PR = Public Relations: media आणि लोकांशी brand ची प्रतिष्ठा व संबंध सांभाळणे, अनेकदा ads साठी पैसे न देता earned (मोफत) coverage मिळवणे.

q.en: What does 'customer retention' mean?
q.hi: 'Customer retention' ka matlab kya hai?
q.mr: 'Customer retention' म्हणजे काय?

en: Getting as many first-time buyers as possible
Collecting customer data for ads targeting
Returning a customer's money after a complaint
Keeping existing customers buying from you over time
hi: Zyada se zyada first-time buyers laana
Ads targeting ke liye customer data collect karna
Complaint ke baad customer ka paisa lautana
Existing customers ko lambe samay tak aapse khareedte rakhna
mr: शक्य तितके नवीन first-time खरेदीदार आणणे
Ads targeting साठी ग्राहकांचा data गोळा करणे
तक्रारीनंतर ग्राहकाचे पैसे परत करणे
सध्याचे ग्राहक दीर्घकाळ तुमच्याकडून खरेदी करत राहतील असे करणे

exp.en: Retention is about keeping existing customers active and buying again. It is usually cheaper than acquiring new customers and raises lifetime value.
exp.hi: Retention ka matlab existing customers ko active rakhna aur dobara khareedwana. Yeh usually naye customers laane se sasta padta hai aur lifetime value badhata hai.
exp.mr: Retention म्हणजे सध्याच्या ग्राहकांना सक्रिय ठेवून पुन्हा खरेदी करायला लावणे. हे सहसा नवीन ग्राहक मिळवण्यापेक्षा स्वस्त पडते आणि lifetime value वाढवते.

q.en: In the PAS copywriting formula, what does the 'A' stand for?
q.hi: PAS copywriting formula mein 'A' ka matlab kya hai?
q.mr: PAS copywriting formula मध्ये 'A' म्हणजे काय?

en: Action
Agitate
Audience
Advantage
hi: Action
Agitate
Audience
Advantage
mr: Action
Agitate
Audience
Advantage

exp.en: PAS = Problem, Agitate, Solution. You name the problem, 'agitate' it by showing how painful it is, then present your product as the solution. 'Action' belongs to AIDA.
exp.hi: PAS = Problem, Agitate, Solution. Pehle problem batao, phir usse 'agitate' karo (dard dikhao), phir product ko solution ki tarah rakho. 'Action' AIDA ka part hai.
exp.mr: PAS = Problem, Agitate, Solution. आधी समस्या सांगा, मग ती किती त्रासदायक आहे हे दाखवून 'agitate' करा आणि शेवटी product उपाय म्हणून मांडा. 'Action' हा AIDA चा भाग आहे.

q.en: What is email list segmentation?
q.hi: Email list segmentation kya hota hai?
q.mr: Email list segmentation म्हणजे काय?

en: Splitting subscribers into groups to send more relevant emails
Sending one email to the whole list at the same time
Breaking a long email into several shorter emails
Removing the unsubscribe link for loyal customers
hi: Subscribers ko groups mein baantna taaki relevant emails jaayein
Poori list ko ek hi time par ek hi email bhejna
Ek lambe email ko kai chhote emails mein todna
Loyal customers ke liye unsubscribe link hata dena
mr: Subscribers ना गटांमध्ये विभागून अधिक relevant emails पाठवणे
संपूर्ण list ला एकाच वेळी एकच email पाठवणे
एका मोठ्या email चे अनेक छोटे emails करणे
Loyal ग्राहकांसाठी unsubscribe link काढून टाकणे

exp.en: Segmentation groups subscribers by traits like location, interests or purchase history, so each group gets relevant content. This usually improves clicks and reduces unsubscribes.
exp.hi: Segmentation mein subscribers ko location, interest ya purchase history jaise traits se group kiya jaata hai, taaki har group ko relevant content mile. Isse clicks badhte hain aur unsubscribes kam hote hain.
exp.mr: Segmentation मध्ये subscribers ना location, आवड किंवा purchase history नुसार गटांत विभागले जाते, म्हणजे प्रत्येक गटाला relevant content मिळते. त्यामुळे clicks वाढतात आणि unsubscribes कमी होतात.

q.en: What is a 'drip campaign' in email marketing?
q.hi: Email marketing mein 'drip campaign' kya hota hai?
q.mr: Email marketing मध्ये 'drip campaign' म्हणजे काय?

en: A campaign that sends one email to a rented list
A campaign that slowly reduces product prices
A single newsletter sent every Monday to everyone
A pre-planned series of automated emails sent over time
hi: Rented list ko ek email bhejne wala campaign
Dheere dheere product prices kam karne wala campaign
Har Monday sabko jaane wala ek newsletter
Time ke saath automatically jaane wale pre-planned emails ki series
mr: भाड्याच्या list ला एक email पाठवणारी campaign
हळूहळू product च्या किमती कमी करणारी campaign
दर Monday सर्वांना जाणारे एकच newsletter
ठराविक अंतराने आपोआप जाणाऱ्या पूर्वनियोजित emails ची मालिका

exp.en: A drip campaign is a sequence of automated emails sent on a schedule or after a trigger (e.g., Day 0 welcome, Day 2 tips, Day 5 offer). A weekly newsletter to all is a broadcast, not a drip.
exp.hi: Drip campaign automated emails ki series hai jo schedule ya trigger ke baad jaati hai (jaise Day 0 welcome, Day 2 tips, Day 5 offer). Sabko jaane wala weekly newsletter broadcast hai, drip nahi.
exp.mr: Drip campaign म्हणजे schedule किंवा trigger नंतर जाणाऱ्या automated emails ची मालिका (उदा. Day 0 welcome, Day 2 tips, Day 5 offer). सर्वांना जाणारे weekly newsletter हे broadcast आहे, drip नाही.

q.en: What does MQL stand for in lead management?
q.hi: Lead management mein MQL ka full form kya hai?
q.mr: Lead management मध्ये MQL चे पूर्ण रूप काय आहे?

en: Most Qualified Lister
Monthly Quota Limit
Marketing Qualified Lead
Media Quality Level
hi: Most Qualified Lister
Monthly Quota Limit
Marketing Qualified Lead
Media Quality Level
mr: Most Qualified Lister
Monthly Quota Limit
Marketing Qualified Lead
Media Quality Level

exp.en: An MQL (Marketing Qualified Lead) has shown enough interest and fit, per marketing's criteria, to be worth passing on. Once sales accepts and qualifies it, it becomes an SQL (Sales Qualified Lead).
exp.hi: MQL (Marketing Qualified Lead) woh lead hai jisne marketing ke criteria ke hisaab se kaafi interest aur fit dikhaya hai. Sales jab usse qualify karti hai toh woh SQL (Sales Qualified Lead) ban jaata hai.
exp.mr: MQL (Marketing Qualified Lead) म्हणजे marketing च्या निकषांनुसार पुरेसा interest आणि fit दाखवलेली lead. Sales ने ती qualify केली की ती SQL (Sales Qualified Lead) बनते.

q.en: What is 'brand positioning'?
q.hi: 'Brand positioning' kya hai?
q.mr: 'Brand positioning' म्हणजे काय?

en: The distinct place a brand wants to hold in customers' minds
The physical shelf location of a product in a shop
The ranking of a brand's website on Google
The position of the logo on the packaging
hi: Customers ke mind mein brand ki alag, khaas jagah
Dukaan mein product ki shelf par jagah
Google par brand ki website ki ranking
Packaging par logo ki position
mr: ग्राहकांच्या मनात brand ला हवी असलेली वेगळी, खास जागा
दुकानात product ची shelf वरील जागा
Google वर brand च्या website ची ranking
Packaging वरील logo ची जागा

exp.en: Positioning is how you want your target customers to think of you compared with competitors, e.g., 'the safest', 'the cheapest', 'the most premium'. All messaging should reinforce it.
exp.hi: Positioning matlab target customers competitors ke comparison mein aapke baare mein kya sochein, jaise 'sabse safe', 'sabse sasta', 'sabse premium'. Saari messaging isi ko strong kare.
exp.mr: Positioning म्हणजे स्पर्धकांच्या तुलनेत target ग्राहकांनी तुमच्याबद्दल काय विचार करावा, उदा. 'सर्वात सुरक्षित', 'सर्वात स्वस्त', 'सर्वात premium'. सर्व messaging ने तेच पक्के करावे.

q.en: What is 'double opt-in' in email marketing?
q.hi: Email marketing mein 'double opt-in' kya hai?
q.mr: Email marketing मध्ये 'double opt-in' म्हणजे काय?

en: Sending every campaign twice to improve open rate
New subscribers confirm via a link in a confirmation email
Asking customers to sign up on two different websites
Adding a contact to two lists at once
hi: Open rate badhane ke liye har campaign do baar bhejna
Naya subscriber confirmation email ke link se confirm karta hai
Customers ko do alag websites par sign up karwana
Ek contact ko ek saath do lists mein daalna
mr: Open rate वाढवण्यासाठी प्रत्येक campaign दोनदा पाठवणे
नवीन subscriber confirmation email मधील link ने खात्री करतो
ग्राहकांना दोन वेगवेगळ्या websites वर sign up करायला लावणे
एक contact एकाच वेळी दोन lists मध्ये टाकणे

exp.en: With double opt-in, a person signs up and then clicks a confirmation link before being added. It keeps fake or mistyped addresses off your list and protects deliverability.
exp.hi: Double opt-in mein person sign up karta hai aur phir confirmation link click karta hai, tabhi list mein add hota hai. Isse fake ya galat addresses list mein nahi aate aur deliverability safe rehti hai.
exp.mr: Double opt-in मध्ये व्यक्ती sign up करते आणि मग confirmation link क्लिक करते, त्यानंतरच list मध्ये जोडली जाते. त्यामुळे fake किंवा चुकीचे addresses येत नाहीत आणि deliverability सुरक्षित राहते.

q.en: In a Reel or short video, what is the 'hook'?
q.hi: Reel ya short video mein 'hook' kya hota hai?
q.mr: Reel किंवा short video मध्ये 'hook' म्हणजे काय?

en: The link to your website in the caption
The background music used in the video
The call-to-action at the very end
The opening line or seconds that stop the scroll
hi: Caption mein website ka link
Video mein use hua background music
Bilkul end mein call-to-action
Shuru ki line ya seconds jo scroll rok de
mr: Caption मधील website ची link
Video मधील background music
अगदी शेवटी असलेला call-to-action
सुरुवातीची ओळ किंवा सेकंद जे scroll थांबवतात

exp.en: The hook is the first line or first few seconds designed to grab attention so viewers don't scroll past. Without a strong hook, even great content gets little watch time.
exp.hi: Hook pehli line ya pehle kuch seconds hote hain jo attention pakadte hain taaki viewer scroll na kare. Strong hook ke bina achha content bhi kam watch time paata hai.
exp.mr: Hook म्हणजे पहिली ओळ किंवा पहिले काही सेकंद जे लक्ष वेधून घेतात, म्हणजे viewer पुढे scroll करत नाही. मजबूत hook शिवाय चांगल्या content लाही कमी watch time मिळतो.

q.en: What is Online Reputation Management (ORM)?
q.hi: Online Reputation Management (ORM) kya hai?
q.mr: Online Reputation Management (ORM) म्हणजे काय?

en: Buying followers to make a brand look popular
Deleting every negative comment about a brand
Monitoring and shaping how a brand is seen online
Running paid ads only on review websites
hi: Brand popular dikhe isliye followers khareedna
Brand ke har negative comment ko delete karna
Brand online kaise dikhta hai use monitor aur shape karna
Sirf review websites par paid ads chalana
mr: Brand लोकप्रिय दिसावा म्हणून followers विकत घेणे
Brand बद्दलची प्रत्येक negative comment delete करणे
Brand online कसा दिसतो ते monitor करून घडवणे
फक्त review websites वर paid ads चालवणे

exp.en: ORM means tracking reviews, mentions and search results about your brand and responding well: thanking fans, fixing complaints, and building genuine positive content. Deleting criticism usually backfires.
exp.hi: ORM matlab brand ke reviews, mentions aur search results track karna aur sahi response dena: fans ko thanks, complaints solve karna, genuine positive content banana. Criticism delete karna usually ulta padta hai.
exp.mr: ORM म्हणजे brand बद्दलचे reviews, mentions आणि search results track करून योग्य प्रतिसाद देणे: चाहत्यांचे आभार, तक्रारी सोडवणे आणि खरे सकारात्मक content तयार करणे. टीका delete केल्यास सहसा उलटा परिणाम होतो.

q.en: In the FAB copywriting framework, which element answers the customer's 'So what's in it for me?'
q.hi: FAB copywriting framework mein kaunsa element customer ke 'Mujhe isse kya milega?' ka jawab deta hai?
q.mr: FAB copywriting framework मध्ये कोणता घटक ग्राहकाच्या 'मला यातून काय मिळणार?' प्रश्नाचे उत्तर देतो?

en: Feature
Advantage
Function
Benefit
hi: Feature
Advantage
Function
Benefit
mr: Feature
Advantage
Function
Benefit

exp.en: FAB = Features, Advantages, Benefits. A feature is what it is (5000 mAh battery), an advantage is what it does (lasts 2 days), and the benefit is what the customer gains (no charging anxiety on trips).
exp.hi: FAB = Features, Advantages, Benefits. Feature = kya hai (5000 mAh battery), advantage = kya karta hai (2 din chalti hai), benefit = customer ko kya milta hai (trip par charging ki tension nahi).
exp.mr: FAB = Features, Advantages, Benefits. Feature = ते काय आहे (5000 mAh battery), advantage = ते काय करते (2 दिवस टिकते), benefit = ग्राहकाला काय मिळते (प्रवासात charging ची काळजी नाही).

q.en: How is email Click-to-Open Rate (CTOR) calculated?
q.hi: Email Click-to-Open Rate (CTOR) kaise calculate hota hai?
q.mr: Email Click-to-Open Rate (CTOR) कसा काढतात?

en: Unique clicks ÷ emails delivered × 100
Unique clicks ÷ unique opens × 100
Unique opens ÷ emails sent × 100
Conversions ÷ unique clicks × 100
hi: Unique clicks ÷ emails delivered × 100
Unique clicks ÷ unique opens × 100
Unique opens ÷ emails sent × 100
Conversions ÷ unique clicks × 100
mr: Unique clicks ÷ emails delivered × 100
Unique clicks ÷ unique opens × 100
Unique opens ÷ emails sent × 100
Conversions ÷ unique clicks × 100

exp.en: CTOR = unique clicks ÷ unique opens × 100. It shows how compelling the email content was to people who opened it. Clicks ÷ delivered is the click-through rate (CTR).
exp.hi: CTOR = unique clicks ÷ unique opens × 100. Yeh batata hai ki open karne walon ko content kitna pasand aaya. Clicks ÷ delivered toh click-through rate (CTR) hai.
exp.mr: CTOR = unique clicks ÷ unique opens × 100. Email उघडणाऱ्यांना content किती आकर्षक वाटले हे यातून कळते. Clicks ÷ delivered म्हणजे click-through rate (CTR).

q.en: In email marketing, what is a 'hard bounce'?
q.hi: Email marketing mein 'hard bounce' kya hota hai?
q.mr: Email marketing मध्ये 'hard bounce' म्हणजे काय?

en: A permanent failure, e.g. the address doesn't exist
A temporary failure because the inbox is full
An email that was delivered but not opened
An email that the recipient marked as spam
hi: Permanent failure, jaise address exist hi nahi karta
Inbox full hone ki wajah se temporary failure
Email deliver hua par open nahi hua
Receiver ne email ko spam mark kiya
mr: कायमचे अपयश, उदा. address अस्तित्वातच नाही
Inbox full असल्यामुळे तात्पुरते अपयश
Email पोहोचला पण उघडला गेला नाही
प्राप्तकर्त्याने email ला spam म्हणून mark केले

exp.en: A hard bounce is a permanent delivery failure (invalid or non-existent address, blocked domain). Remove such addresses immediately. A full inbox is a soft (temporary) bounce.
exp.hi: Hard bounce permanent delivery failure hai (invalid ya non-existent address, blocked domain). Aise addresses turant hatao. Inbox full hona soft (temporary) bounce hai.
exp.mr: Hard bounce म्हणजे कायमचे delivery अपयश (अवैध किंवा अस्तित्वात नसलेला address, blocked domain). असे addresses लगेच काढा. Inbox full असणे हे soft (तात्पुरते) bounce आहे.

q.en: Which content piece best fits the BOFU (bottom of funnel) stage?
q.hi: BOFU (bottom of funnel) stage ke liye kaunsa content sabse sahi hai?
q.mr: BOFU (bottom of funnel) टप्प्यासाठी कोणते content सर्वात योग्य आहे?

en: A funny meme about Monday mornings
A general blog: '10 facts about digital marketing'
A pricing comparison with a free demo offer
An industry news roundup newsletter
hi: Monday morning par funny meme
General blog: 'Digital marketing ke 10 facts'
Free demo offer ke saath pricing comparison
Industry news roundup newsletter
mr: Monday morning वरचा मजेदार meme
सर्वसाधारण blog: 'Digital marketing बद्दल 10 facts'
Free demo ऑफरसह pricing comparison
Industry news roundup newsletter

exp.en: BOFU content helps people who are ready to decide: pricing pages, comparisons, case studies, demos and trials. Memes and general blogs are TOFU awareness content.
exp.hi: BOFU content decide karne ke liye ready logon ki madad karta hai: pricing pages, comparisons, case studies, demos aur trials. Memes aur general blogs TOFU awareness content hain.
exp.mr: BOFU content निर्णय घ्यायला तयार असलेल्यांना मदत करते: pricing pages, comparisons, case studies, demos आणि trials. Memes आणि सर्वसाधारण blogs हे TOFU awareness content आहे.

q.en: In Net Promoter Score (NPS) on a 0–10 scale, which scores count as 'promoters'?
q.hi: 0–10 scale wale Net Promoter Score (NPS) mein kaunse scores 'promoters' gine jaate hain?
q.mr: 0–10 scale वरील Net Promoter Score (NPS) मध्ये कोणते scores 'promoters' मानले जातात?

en: 7 and above
9 and 10
Only 10
6 and above
hi: 7 aur upar
9 aur 10
Sirf 10
6 aur upar
mr: 7 आणि त्यावरील
फक्त 10
6 आणि त्यावरील

exp.en: In NPS, 9–10 are promoters, 7–8 passives and 0–6 detractors. NPS = % promoters − % detractors, so it ranges from −100 to +100.
exp.hi: NPS mein 9–10 promoters, 7–8 passives aur 0–6 detractors hote hain. NPS = % promoters − % detractors, isliye range −100 se +100 tak hoti hai.
exp.mr: NPS मध्ये 9–10 promoters, 7–8 passives आणि 0–6 detractors असतात. NPS = % promoters − % detractors, म्हणून त्याची range −100 ते +100 असते.

q.en: What is 'preheader' text in an email?
q.hi: Email mein 'preheader' text kya hota hai?
q.mr: Email मधील 'preheader' text म्हणजे काय?

en: The sender name shown in the inbox list
The legal footer with the company's address
The alt text of the email's first image
Preview text shown after the subject line
hi: Inbox list mein dikhne wala sender name
Company address wala legal footer
Email ki pehli image ka alt text
Subject line ke baad dikhne wala preview text
mr: Inbox list मध्ये दिसणारे sender name
Company चा address असलेला legal footer
Email मधील पहिल्या image चा alt text
Subject line नंतर दिसणारा preview text

exp.en: Preheader text is the short preview shown next to or below the subject line in most inboxes. Use it to add to the subject line; if left empty, the inbox may show random text like 'View in browser'.
exp.hi: Preheader text subject line ke saath/neeche dikhne wala chhota preview hai. Isse subject line ko support karo; khaali chhodoge toh inbox 'View in browser' jaisa random text dikha sakta hai.
exp.mr: Preheader text म्हणजे बहुतेक inboxes मध्ये subject line शेजारी/खाली दिसणारा छोटा preview. त्याने subject line ला पूरक माहिती द्या; रिकामा ठेवला तर 'View in browser' सारखा कोणताही text दिसू शकतो.

q.en: In content strategy, what is a 'pillar page'?
q.hi: Content strategy mein 'pillar page' kya hota hai?
q.mr: Content strategy मध्ये 'pillar page' म्हणजे काय?

en: An in-depth page on a core topic, linking to related posts
The website's contact page with the office address and map
A landing page that lists only paid advertising offers
A short social post pinned to the top of your profile
hi: Core topic par detailed page jo related posts se link kare
Office address aur map wala website ka contact page
Sirf paid advertising offers wala landing page
Profile ke top par pinned chhota social post
mr: मुख्य विषयावरील सविस्तर page जे संबंधित posts ना link करते
Office address आणि map असलेले website चे contact page
फक्त paid advertising offers असलेले landing page
Profile च्या वर pin केलेली छोटी social post

exp.en: A pillar page covers a core topic comprehensively and links to 'cluster' articles on subtopics, which link back. This topic-cluster structure helps users and search engines understand your expertise.
exp.hi: Pillar page ek core topic ko poori tarah cover karta hai aur subtopics wale 'cluster' articles se link karta hai, jo wapas link karte hain. Yeh topic-cluster structure users aur search engines dono ko aapki expertise samjhata hai.
exp.mr: Pillar page एका मुख्य विषयाचा सविस्तर आढावा घेते आणि उपविषयांवरील 'cluster' articles शी link करते, जे परत link करतात. ही topic-cluster रचना users आणि search engines दोघांना तुमचे कौशल्य समजायला मदत करते.

q.en: A Pune bakery has 600 customers who ordered once via WhatsApp but rarely return. With almost no budget, what is the best first step?
q.hi: Pune ki ek bakery ke 600 customers ne WhatsApp se ek baar order kiya par wapas kam aate hain. Budget lagbhag zero hai. Best first step kya hai?
q.mr: Pune मधील एका bakery च्या 600 ग्राहकांनी WhatsApp वरून एकदा order केली पण ते क्वचितच परत येतात. Budget जवळजवळ शून्य आहे. सर्वोत्तम पहिले पाऊल कोणते?

en: Buy a list of 10,000 local numbers and message them all
Stop using WhatsApp and put all effort into Google Ads
Start a simple loyalty reward and message opted-in buyers
Post the same offer 5 times a day on every platform
hi: 10,000 local numbers ki list khareedo aur sabko message karo
WhatsApp use karna band karo aur saara effort Google Ads mein daalo
Simple loyalty reward shuru karo aur opted-in buyers ko message karo
Har platform par din mein 5 baar same offer post karo
mr: 10,000 स्थानिक numbers ची list विकत घेऊन सगळ्यांना message करा
WhatsApp वापरणे बंद करून सगळे लक्ष Google Ads वर द्या
साधे loyalty reward सुरू करा आणि opted-in खरेदीदारांना message करा
प्रत्येक platform वर दिवसातून 5 वेळा तीच offer post करा

exp.en: Existing customers already trust you, so a simple reward (e.g., a treat on the 5th order) plus relevant, permission-based updates is the cheapest way to lift repeat orders. Bought lists are unconsented spam and risk your WhatsApp number being blocked.
exp.hi: Existing customers pehle se trust karte hain, isliye simple reward (jaise 5th order par treat) aur permission-based relevant updates repeat orders badhane ka sabse sasta tareeka hai. Khareedi hui list bina consent ka spam hai aur WhatsApp number block ho sakta hai.
exp.mr: सध्याचे ग्राहक आधीच विश्वास ठेवतात, म्हणून साधे reward (उदा. 5 व्या order वर treat) आणि परवानगी घेऊन पाठवलेले relevant updates हा repeat orders वाढवण्याचा सर्वात स्वस्त मार्ग आहे. विकत घेतलेली list म्हणजे संमतीशिवाय spam, त्यामुळे WhatsApp number block होऊ शकतो.

q.en: Which is an example of implicit (behavioural) lead-scoring data?
q.hi: Implicit (behavioural) lead-scoring data ka example kaunsa hai?
q.mr: Implicit (behavioural) lead-scoring data चे उदाहरण कोणते?

en: The lead's job title is 'Marketing Manager'
The lead visited the pricing page three times this week
The lead's company has 200 employees
The lead is located in Bengaluru
hi: Lead ka job title 'Marketing Manager' hai
Lead ne is hafte pricing page teen baar dekha
Lead ki company mein 200 employees hain
Lead Bengaluru mein hai
mr: Lead चे job title 'Marketing Manager' आहे
Lead ने या आठवड्यात pricing page तीन वेळा पाहिले
Lead च्या company मध्ये 200 कर्मचारी आहेत
Lead Bengaluru मध्ये आहे

exp.en: Implicit data comes from behaviour (page visits, email clicks, downloads). Job title, company size and location are explicit (fit/firmographic) data the lead provides or you look up.
exp.hi: Implicit data behaviour se aata hai (page visits, email clicks, downloads). Job title, company size aur location explicit (fit/firmographic) data hai jo lead deta hai ya aap dhoondhte ho.
exp.mr: Implicit data वर्तनातून येतो (page visits, email clicks, downloads). Job title, company size आणि location हा explicit (fit/firmographic) data आहे जो lead देते किंवा तुम्ही शोधता.

q.en: What are SPF, DKIM and DMARC used for in email marketing?
q.hi: Email marketing mein SPF, DKIM aur DMARC kis kaam aate hain?
q.mr: Email marketing मध्ये SPF, DKIM आणि DMARC कशासाठी वापरतात?

en: Authenticating that emails really come from your domain
Designing responsive email templates for mobile
Measuring open and click rates of campaigns
Compressing images so emails load faster
hi: Yeh prove karna ki emails sach mein aapke domain se aa rahe hain
Mobile ke liye responsive email templates design karna
Campaigns ke open aur click rates measure karna
Images compress karna taaki email jaldi load ho
mr: Emails खरोखर तुमच्याच domain वरून येतात हे सिद्ध करणे
Mobile साठी responsive email templates design करणे
Campaigns चे open आणि click rates मोजणे
Email लवकर load व्हावा म्हणून images compress करणे

exp.en: SPF lists servers allowed to send for your domain, DKIM adds a cryptographic signature, and DMARC tells inboxes what to do if checks fail. Together they prevent spoofing and improve deliverability.
exp.hi: SPF batata hai kaunse servers aapke domain se bhej sakte hain, DKIM cryptographic signature lagata hai, aur DMARC inbox ko batata hai checks fail hone par kya karna hai. Teeno milkar spoofing rokte hain aur deliverability sudharte hain.
exp.mr: SPF सांगते कोणते servers तुमच्या domain कडून पाठवू शकतात, DKIM cryptographic signature जोडते आणि DMARC checks fail झाल्यास inbox ने काय करावे ते सांगते. तिन्ही मिळून spoofing थांबवतात आणि deliverability सुधारतात.

q.en: On the WhatsApp Business Platform (API), how must you message a customer who hasn't messaged you in the last 24 hours?
q.hi: WhatsApp Business Platform (API) par jis customer ne pichhle 24 ghante mein message nahi kiya, use kaise message karna padta hai?
q.mr: WhatsApp Business Platform (API) वर ज्या ग्राहकाने मागील 24 तासांत message केलेला नाही, त्याला कसा message करावा लागतो?

en: Any free-form text, as long as it has no links
Only through a voice call first
By adding them to a WhatsApp group
Only with a pre-approved message template
hi: Koi bhi free-form text, bas usmein link na ho
Pehle sirf voice call ke through
Unhe WhatsApp group mein add karke
Sirf pre-approved message template se
mr: कोणताही free-form text, फक्त त्यात link नसावी
आधी फक्त voice call करून
त्यांना WhatsApp group मध्ये जोडून
फक्त pre-approved message template वापरून

exp.en: Free-form replies are allowed only within 24 hours of the customer's last message (the customer service window). Outside it, businesses must use templates approved by Meta, and only to users who opted in.
exp.hi: Free-form replies sirf customer ke last message ke 24 ghante ke andar allowed hain (customer service window). Uske bahar Meta se approved templates hi use karne padte hain, woh bhi opted-in users ko.
exp.mr: Free-form उत्तरे फक्त ग्राहकाच्या शेवटच्या message नंतर 24 तासांत (customer service window) चालतात. त्यानंतर Meta ने approve केलेले templates च वापरावे लागतात, तेही फक्त opt-in केलेल्या users ना.

q.en: What is 'evergreen content'?
q.hi: 'Evergreen content' kya hota hai?
q.mr: 'Evergreen content' म्हणजे काय?

en: Content about environment and sustainability only
Content posted every day without a break
Content that stays relevant and useful for a long time
Content that is promoted only with paid ads
hi: Sirf environment aur sustainability wala content
Bina break roz post hone wala content
Aisa content jo lambe samay tak relevant aur useful rahe
Sirf paid ads se promote hone wala content
mr: फक्त पर्यावरण आणि sustainability वरील content
रोज न चुकता post होणारे content
दीर्घकाळ relevant आणि उपयुक्त राहणारे content
फक्त paid ads ने promote होणारे content

exp.en: Evergreen content (e.g., 'How to write a resume', 'What is GST') stays useful for years and keeps bringing traffic, unlike news or trend posts that fade quickly.
exp.hi: Evergreen content (jaise 'Resume kaise likhein', 'GST kya hai') saalon tak useful rehta hai aur traffic laata rehta hai, news ya trend posts ki tarah jaldi fade nahi hota.
exp.mr: Evergreen content (उदा. 'Resume कसा लिहावा', 'GST म्हणजे काय') वर्षानुवर्षे उपयुक्त राहते आणि traffic आणत राहते, news किंवा trend posts सारखे लवकर जुने होत नाही.

q.en: A Nagpur coaching institute got 2,000 leads from a free webinar. Counsellors call everyone in random order and complain most leads are 'useless'. What should you set up?
q.hi: Nagpur ke ek coaching institute ko free webinar se 2,000 leads mile. Counsellors sabko random order mein call karte hain aur kehte hain zyada leads 'bekaar' hain. Aapko kya set up karna chahiye?
q.mr: Nagpur मधील एका coaching institute ला free webinar मधून 2,000 leads मिळाल्या. Counsellors सगळ्यांना कोणत्याही क्रमाने call करतात आणि म्हणतात बहुतेक leads 'निरुपयोगी' आहेत. तुम्ही काय set up करावे?

en: Lead scoring with agreed MQL rules, and nurture emails for the rest
A bigger webinar next month to get 5,000 more leads
A rule that counsellors must call every lead 5 times
An instruction to delete all leads older than one week
hi: Agreed MQL rules ke saath lead scoring, aur baaki ke liye nurture emails
Agle mahine bada webinar, taaki 5,000 aur leads milein
Rule ki counsellors har lead ko 5 baar call karein
Ek hafte se purane saare leads delete karne ka instruction
mr: ठरलेल्या MQL नियमांसह lead scoring, आणि उरलेल्यांसाठी nurture emails
पुढच्या महिन्यात 5,000 आणखी leads साठी मोठा webinar
Counsellors नी प्रत्येक lead ला 5 वेळा call करावा असा नियम
एका आठवड्यापेक्षा जुन्या सगळ्या leads delete करण्याची सूचना

exp.en: Scoring leads on fit (class, exam, city) and engagement (attended full webinar, asked about fees) lets counsellors call the hottest first, while others are nurtured until ready. More volume just adds more noise.
exp.hi: Leads ko fit (class, exam, city) aur engagement (poora webinar dekha, fees poochhi) par score karne se counsellors pehle hot leads ko call karte hain, baaki nurture hote hain jab tak ready na hon. Sirf volume badhane se noise badhta hai.
exp.mr: Fit (class, exam, शहर) आणि engagement (पूर्ण webinar पाहिला, fees विचारली) नुसार leads ना score केल्यास counsellors आधी hot leads ना call करतात, बाकीच्यांना तयार होईपर्यंत nurture केले जाते. फक्त संख्या वाढवल्याने गोंधळच वाढतो.

q.en: Your D2C snacks brand sees many shoppers add items to cart and leave without paying. Which automation should you build first?
q.hi: Aapke D2C snacks brand par bahut shoppers cart mein items daalkar bina pay kiye chale jaate hain. Sabse pehle kaunsa automation banana chahiye?
q.mr: तुमच्या D2C snacks brand वर अनेक shoppers cart मध्ये items टाकून पैसे न भरता निघून जातात. सर्वात आधी कोणते automation बनवावे?

en: A monthly newsletter to the full list with brand news
An abandoned-cart reminder sequence sent within hours
A birthday email asking customers for their date of birth
A yearly survey asking about packaging preferences
hi: Poori list ko brand news wala monthly newsletter
Kuch ghanton mein jaane wala abandoned-cart reminder sequence
Customers se date of birth maangne wala birthday email
Packaging preferences poochhne wala saalana survey
mr: संपूर्ण list ला brand news असलेले monthly newsletter
काही तासांत जाणारा abandoned-cart reminder sequence
ग्राहकांची जन्मतारीख विचारणारा birthday email
Packaging आवडीनिवडी विचारणारा वार्षिक survey

exp.en: Cart abandoners have shown very high purchase intent, so a timely reminder (often a first message within a few hours, then 1–2 follow-ups) recovers revenue quickly. The other options don't target this leak.
exp.hi: Cart abandoners ne high purchase intent dikhaya hai, isliye timely reminder (aksar kuch ghanton mein pehla message, phir 1–2 follow-ups) jaldi revenue wapas laata hai. Baaki options is leak ko target nahi karte.
exp.mr: Cart सोडणाऱ्यांनी खरेदीची तीव्र इच्छा दाखवली आहे, म्हणून वेळेवर reminder (सहसा काही तासांत पहिला message, मग 1–2 follow-ups) लवकर revenue परत आणतो. इतर पर्याय ही गळती थांबवत नाहीत.

q.en: A dental clinic gets a 1-star Google review saying 'rude staff, waited 2 hours'. What is the best response?
q.hi: Ek dental clinic ko Google par 1-star review mila: 'rude staff, 2 ghante wait kiya'. Best response kya hai?
q.mr: एका dental clinic ला Google वर 1-star review मिळाला: 'उद्धट staff, 2 तास थांबावे लागले'. सर्वोत्तम प्रतिसाद कोणता?

en: Reply with the patient's treatment details to prove them wrong
Ask friends to post five 5-star reviews to bury it
Ignore it, since replying draws more attention
Reply politely, apologise for the experience and invite them to talk offline
hi: Patient ke treatment details reply mein daalkar unhe galat saabit karo
Doston se 5 five-star reviews dalwao taaki yeh neeche chala jaaye
Ignore karo, reply karne se aur attention milega
Politely reply karo, experience ke liye sorry bolo aur offline baat karne bulao
mr: रुग्णाच्या उपचारांची माहिती reply मध्ये टाकून त्यांना चुकीचे ठरवा
मित्रांकडून पाच 5-star reviews टाकून हा review खाली ढकला
दुर्लक्ष करा, reply केल्याने जास्त लक्ष जाते
नम्रपणे reply करा, अनुभवाबद्दल दिलगिरी व्यक्त करा आणि offline बोलायला बोलवा

exp.en: A calm, public, empathetic reply shows future patients you care, and moving the details offline protects patient privacy. Fake reviews break Google's policies, and ignoring it looks careless.
exp.hi: Calm, public aur empathetic reply future patients ko dikhata hai ki aap care karte ho, aur details offline le jaane se patient privacy safe rehti hai. Fake reviews Google policy ke khilaaf hain aur ignore karna laparwahi lagta hai.
exp.mr: शांत, सार्वजनिक आणि सहानुभूतीपूर्ण reply भावी रुग्णांना दाखवतो की तुम्हाला काळजी आहे, आणि तपशील offline नेल्याने रुग्णाची गोपनीयता जपली जाते. Fake reviews Google च्या policy विरुद्ध आहेत आणि दुर्लक्ष करणे बेफिकीर वाटते.

q.en: In the StoryBrand messaging framework, who is the 'hero' of the story?
q.hi: StoryBrand messaging framework mein story ka 'hero' kaun hota hai?
q.mr: StoryBrand messaging framework मध्ये कथेचा 'hero' कोण असतो?

en: The brand's founder
The brand itself
The customer
The competitor
hi: Brand ka founder
Khud brand
Customer
Competitor
mr: Brand चा founder
स्वतः brand
ग्राहक
स्पर्धक

exp.en: StoryBrand (Donald Miller) makes the customer the hero who has a problem; the brand is the guide that gives them a plan and helps them succeed. Brands that cast themselves as the hero tend to lose attention.
exp.hi: StoryBrand (Donald Miller) mein customer hero hota hai jiske paas problem hai; brand guide hai jo plan deta hai aur success dilata hai. Jo brands khud ko hero banate hain, woh attention kho dete hain.
exp.mr: StoryBrand (Donald Miller) मध्ये ग्राहक हा समस्या असलेला hero असतो; brand हा guide असतो जो plan देतो आणि यशस्वी व्हायला मदत करतो. स्वतःला hero बनवणारे brands लक्ष गमावतात.

q.en: Which formula gives the Customer Retention Rate for a period? (S = customers at start, E = at end, N = new customers acquired)
q.hi: Kisi period ka Customer Retention Rate kaunse formula se nikalta hai? (S = start ke customers, E = end ke, N = naye customers)
q.mr: एखाद्या कालावधीचा Customer Retention Rate कोणत्या formula ने काढतात? (S = सुरुवातीचे ग्राहक, E = शेवटचे, N = नवीन ग्राहक)

exp.en: Retention rate = ((E − N) ÷ S) × 100. You subtract new customers so only the ones you kept from the start are counted. Example: start 200, end 210, new 30 → (180 ÷ 200) × 100 = 90%.
exp.hi: Retention rate = ((E − N) ÷ S) × 100. Naye customers minus karte hain taaki sirf start wale retained customers gine jaayein. Example: start 200, end 210, new 30 → (180 ÷ 200) × 100 = 90%.
exp.mr: Retention rate = ((E − N) ÷ S) × 100. नवीन ग्राहक वजा करतात म्हणजे फक्त सुरुवातीपासून टिकलेले ग्राहक मोजले जातात. उदा. सुरुवात 200, शेवट 210, नवीन 30 → (180 ÷ 200) × 100 = 90%.

q.en: In customer segmentation, what does RFM stand for?
q.hi: Customer segmentation mein RFM ka full form kya hai?
q.mr: Customer segmentation मध्ये RFM चे पूर्ण रूप काय आहे?

en: Reach, Frequency, Media
Revenue, Funnel, Margin
Referral, Feedback, Membership
Recency, Frequency, Monetary value
hi: Reach, Frequency, Media
Revenue, Funnel, Margin
Referral, Feedback, Membership
Recency, Frequency, Monetary value
mr: Reach, Frequency, Media
Revenue, Funnel, Margin
Referral, Feedback, Membership
Recency, Frequency, Monetary value

exp.en: RFM scores customers on how recently they bought, how often they buy, and how much they spend. It quickly finds champions, at-risk and lapsed customers for retention campaigns. 'Reach, Frequency' is media-planning language.
exp.hi: RFM customers ko score karta hai: kitna recently khareeda, kitni baar khareedte hain, kitna kharch karte hain. Isse champions, at-risk aur lapsed customers jaldi mil jaate hain. 'Reach, Frequency' media planning ki language hai.
exp.mr: RFM ग्राहकांना score करते: किती अलीकडे खरेदी केली, किती वेळा करतात आणि किती खर्च करतात. त्यातून champions, at-risk आणि lapsed ग्राहक पटकन ओळखता येतात. 'Reach, Frequency' ही media planning ची भाषा आहे.

q.en: Since Apple's Mail Privacy Protection launched (2021), why are email open rates less reliable?
q.hi: Apple ke Mail Privacy Protection (2021) ke baad email open rates kam reliable kyun ho gaye?
q.mr: Apple चे Mail Privacy Protection (2021) आल्यापासून email open rates कमी विश्वासार्ह का झाले?

en: It blocks all marketing emails from reaching the inbox
It can preload tracking pixels, logging opens that aren't real
It hides the subject line until the user taps the email
It deletes emails that are not opened within 24 hours
hi: Yeh saare marketing emails ko inbox tak pahunchne se rokta hai
Yeh tracking pixels preload kar sakta hai, jisse fake opens record hote hain
Yeh user ke tap karne tak subject line chhupata hai
Yeh 24 ghante mein na khule emails delete kar deta hai
mr: ते सर्व marketing emails inbox पर्यंत पोहोचू देत नाही
ते tracking pixels आधीच load करू शकते, त्यामुळे खोटे opens नोंदवले जातात
User email tap करेपर्यंत ते subject line लपवते
24 तासांत न उघडलेले emails ते delete करते

exp.en: With MPP enabled, Apple's servers can download email images (including the open-tracking pixel) in the background, so opens get inflated. Clicks and conversions are now more trustworthy signals.
exp.hi: MPP on hone par Apple ke servers background mein email images (open-tracking pixel samet) download kar sakte hain, isliye opens inflate ho jaate hain. Ab clicks aur conversions zyada bharosemand signals hain.
exp.mr: MPP सुरू असल्यास Apple चे servers पार्श्वभूमीत email images (open-tracking pixel सह) download करू शकतात, त्यामुळे opens फुगतात. आता clicks आणि conversions हे अधिक विश्वासार्ह संकेत आहेत.

q.en: A B2B software firm: marketing reports 500 MQLs this month, but sales says only 20 were worth a call and ignores the rest. What is the root fix?
q.hi: Ek B2B software firm: marketing kehti hai is mahine 500 MQLs diye, par sales kehti hai sirf 20 call karne layak the aur baaki ignore karti hai. Root fix kya hai?
q.mr: एका B2B software firm मध्ये marketing म्हणते या महिन्यात 500 MQLs दिल्या, पण sales म्हणते फक्त 20 call करण्यायोग्य होत्या आणि बाकीकडे दुर्लक्ष करते. मूळ उपाय काय?

en: Double the MQL target so sales gets more leads to choose from
Let the sales team buy their own lead lists instead
Agree shared MQL/SQL definitions and a sales–marketing SLA
Stop scoring and send every form fill to sales instantly
hi: MQL target double karo taaki sales ke paas chunne ko zyada leads hon
Sales team ko apni lead lists khud khareedne do
Shared MQL/SQL definitions aur sales–marketing SLA tay karo
Scoring band karo aur har form fill turant sales ko bhejo
mr: MQL target दुप्पट करा म्हणजे sales ला निवडायला जास्त leads मिळतील
Sales team ला स्वतःच्या lead lists विकत घेऊ द्या
सामायिक MQL/SQL व्याख्या आणि sales–marketing SLA ठरवा
Scoring बंद करा आणि प्रत्येक form fill लगेच sales ला पाठवा

exp.en: The gap is misalignment, not volume. Jointly defining what qualifies a lead, committing to follow-up times (SLA), and feeding back why leads were rejected lets scoring improve every month.
exp.hi: Problem alignment ka hai, volume ka nahi. Milkar tay karo lead kab qualify hoti hai, follow-up time par commit karo (SLA), aur reject hone ki wajah feedback karo taaki scoring har mahine behtar ho.
exp.mr: समस्या संख्येची नाही, ताळमेळाची आहे. Lead कधी qualify होते हे एकत्र ठरवणे, follow-up वेळेची बांधिलकी (SLA) आणि leads का नाकारल्या याचा feedback दिल्यास scoring दर महिन्याला सुधारते.

q.en: You moved your newsletter to a brand-new sending domain and want to email all 50,000 subscribers. What's the best approach?
q.hi: Aapne newsletter ko bilkul naye sending domain par shift kiya hai aur saare 50,000 subscribers ko email karna hai. Best approach kya hai?
q.mr: तुम्ही newsletter नवीन sending domain वर हलवले आहे आणि सर्व 50,000 subscribers ना email करायचा आहे. सर्वोत्तम पद्धत कोणती?

en: Warm up gradually, starting with your most engaged subscribers
Send to all 50,000 on day one to build reputation fast
Send to your oldest, least active subscribers first
Use a new domain every week to avoid spam filters
hi: Dheere dheere warm up karo, sabse engaged subscribers se shuru karke
Reputation jaldi banane ke liye pehle hi din saare 50,000 ko bhejo
Pehle sabse purane, kam active subscribers ko bhejo
Spam filters se bachne ke liye har hafte naya domain use karo
mr: हळूहळू warm up करा, सर्वात engaged subscribers पासून सुरुवात करून
Reputation लवकर बनवण्यासाठी पहिल्याच दिवशी सर्व 50,000 ना पाठवा
आधी सर्वात जुन्या, कमी सक्रिय subscribers ना पाठवा
Spam filters टाळण्यासाठी दर आठवड्याला नवीन domain वापरा

exp.en: A new domain has no reputation, so a sudden spike looks like spam. Ramping up volume over weeks, starting with people who open and click, builds positive signals. Rotating domains is a spammer tactic.
exp.hi: Naye domain ki koi reputation nahi hoti, isliye achanak spike spam jaisa dikhta hai. Hafton mein dheere volume badhao, open aur click karne walon se shuru karke, taaki positive signals banein. Domains rotate karna spammers ka tareeka hai.
exp.mr: नवीन domain ला reputation नसते, म्हणून अचानक मोठा volume spam सारखा दिसतो. आठवड्यांमध्ये हळूहळू volume वाढवा, open आणि click करणाऱ्यांपासून सुरुवात करून, म्हणजे चांगले संकेत तयार होतात. Domains बदलत राहणे ही spammers ची युक्ती आहे.

q.en: In a classic positioning statement ('For [target] who [need], [brand] is the [category] that [benefit]. Unlike [competitor]...'), what does the 'Unlike' part communicate?
q.hi: Classic positioning statement ('For [target] who [need], [brand] is the [category] that [benefit]. Unlike [competitor]...') mein 'Unlike' wala part kya batata hai?
q.mr: Classic positioning statement ('For [target] who [need], [brand] is the [category] that [benefit]. Unlike [competitor]...') मध्ये 'Unlike' भाग काय सांगतो?

en: The price discount compared with last year
The list of channels where ads will run
The brand's founding story and history
The key point of difference versus alternatives
hi: Pichhle saal ke comparison mein price discount
Channels ki list jahan ads chalenge
Brand ki founding story aur history
Alternatives ke comparison mein main point of difference
mr: मागील वर्षाच्या तुलनेत किमतीतील सवलत
Ads चालणाऱ्या channels ची यादी
Brand ची स्थापना कथा आणि इतिहास
पर्यायांच्या तुलनेत मुख्य वेगळेपणा

exp.en: The 'Unlike [competitor], our product [differentiator]' line states why customers should choose you over alternatives. Without a clear difference, positioning collapses into 'me too'.
exp.hi: 'Unlike [competitor], our product [differentiator]' wali line batati hai ki customer alternatives ke bajaye aapko kyun chune. Clear difference ke bina positioning 'me too' ban jaati hai.
exp.mr: 'Unlike [competitor], our product [differentiator]' ही ओळ सांगते की ग्राहकाने पर्यायांऐवजी तुम्हालाच का निवडावे. स्पष्ट वेगळेपणा नसेल तर positioning 'me too' होते.

q.en: An online saree seller used the WhatsApp Business app's broadcast list to message 800 contacts, but many never received it. What is the most likely reason?
q.hi: Ek online saree seller ne WhatsApp Business app ki broadcast list se 800 contacts ko message bheja, par bahut logon ko mila hi nahi. Sabse likely reason kya hai?
q.mr: एका online साडी विक्रेत्याने WhatsApp Business app च्या broadcast list मधून 800 contacts ना message पाठवला, पण अनेकांना तो मिळालाच नाही. सर्वात संभाव्य कारण कोणते?

en: Broadcasts work only between 9 AM and 6 PM each day
Only contacts who saved your number receive broadcasts
Broadcasts are delivered only to users on iPhone
Messages containing a price are blocked automatically
hi: Broadcasts roz sirf 9 AM se 6 PM ke beech chalte hain
Broadcast sirf unhe milta hai jinhone aapka number save kiya
Broadcast sirf iPhone users ko deliver hota hai
Price wale messages automatically block ho jaate hain
mr: Broadcasts रोज फक्त सकाळी 9 ते संध्याकाळी 6 चालतात
तुमचा number save केलेल्यांनाच broadcast मिळतो
Broadcast फक्त iPhone users ना पोहोचतो
किंमत असलेले messages आपोआप block होतात

exp.en: In the WhatsApp (Business) app, a broadcast is delivered only to recipients who have your number saved. Ask customers to save your number, or use the WhatsApp Business Platform with opted-in templates for larger sends.
exp.hi: WhatsApp (Business) app mein broadcast sirf unhi ko jaata hai jinke paas aapka number saved hai. Customers se number save karwao, ya bade sends ke liye opted-in templates ke saath WhatsApp Business Platform use karo.
exp.mr: WhatsApp (Business) app मध्ये broadcast फक्त ज्यांनी तुमचा number save केला आहे त्यांनाच जातो. ग्राहकांना number save करायला सांगा, किंवा मोठ्या sends साठी opt-in templates सह WhatsApp Business Platform वापरा.

q.en: Under Gmail and Yahoo's bulk-sender rules (from February 2024), which is a requirement for marketing emails?
q.hi: Gmail aur Yahoo ke bulk-sender rules (February 2024 se) mein marketing emails ke liye kya zaroori hai?
q.mr: Gmail आणि Yahoo च्या bulk-sender नियमांनुसार (February 2024 पासून) marketing emails साठी काय आवश्यक आहे?

en: Every marketing email must include at least one image
Bulk emails may be sent only on weekdays, never weekends
One-click unsubscribe, spam complaint rate below 0.3%
Subject lines must be shorter than 30 characters
hi: Har marketing email mein kam se kam ek image honi chahiye
Bulk emails sirf weekdays par, weekends par kabhi nahi
One-click unsubscribe, spam complaint rate 0.3% se neeche
Subject lines 30 characters se chhoti honi chahiye
mr: प्रत्येक marketing email मध्ये किमान एक image असावी
Bulk emails फक्त आठवड्याच्या दिवशी, weekends ला कधीच नाही
One-click unsubscribe, spam complaint rate 0.3% पेक्षा कमी
Subject lines 30 characters पेक्षा लहान असाव्यात

exp.en: Since 2024, bulk senders to Gmail and Yahoo must authenticate (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), offer one-click unsubscribe, and keep spam complaints below 0.3%. Images, send days and subject length are not rules.
exp.hi: 2024 se Gmail aur Yahoo ke bulk senders ko authenticate karna (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), one-click unsubscribe dena aur spam complaints 0.3% se neeche rakhna zaroori hai. Images, din ya subject length rules nahi hain.
exp.mr: 2024 पासून Gmail आणि Yahoo ला bulk पाठवणाऱ्यांनी authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), one-click unsubscribe देणे आणि spam complaints 0.3% पेक्षा कमी ठेवणे आवश्यक आहे. Images, दिवस किंवा subject ची लांबी हे नियम नाहीत.

q.en: What is a 'sunset policy' in email marketing?
q.hi: Email marketing mein 'sunset policy' kya hoti hai?
q.mr: Email marketing मध्ये 'sunset policy' म्हणजे काय?

en: Suppressing subscribers still inactive after a re-engagement try
Sending every campaign in the evening to get better open rates
Pausing all email sends during the festival season rush
Deleting the brand's old email templates at the end of each year
hi: Re-engagement try ke baad bhi inactive subscribers ko suppress karna
Better open rates ke liye har campaign shaam ko bhejna
Festival season ki bheed mein saare email sends rok dena
Har saal ke end mein brand ke purane email templates delete karna
mr: Re-engagement प्रयत्नानंतरही निष्क्रिय subscribers ना suppress करणे
चांगल्या open rates साठी प्रत्येक campaign संध्याकाळी पाठवणे
सणासुदीच्या गर्दीत सर्व email sends थांबवणे
दरवर्षी शेवटी brand चे जुने email templates delete करणे

exp.en: A sunset policy defines when unengaged subscribers (e.g., no clicks for 6–12 months) get a last re-engagement attempt and are then suppressed. Mailing people who never engage hurts sender reputation.
exp.hi: Sunset policy tay karti hai ki unengaged subscribers (jaise 6–12 mahine se koi click nahi) ko aakhri re-engagement try milegi, phir suppress kiya jaayega. Kabhi engage na karne walon ko mail karna sender reputation bigaadta hai.
exp.mr: Sunset policy ठरवते की unengaged subscribers ना (उदा. 6–12 महिने एकही click नाही) शेवटचा re-engagement प्रयत्न मिळेल आणि मग suppress केले जाईल. कधीच engage न करणाऱ्यांना mail केल्याने sender reputation खराब होते.

q.en: In lead qualification, what does BANT stand for?
q.hi: Lead qualification mein BANT ka full form kya hai?
q.mr: Lead qualification मध्ये BANT चे पूर्ण रूप काय आहे?

en: Brand, Audience, Niche, Traffic
Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline
Benefit, Action, Nurture, Trust
Business, Analytics, Network, Target
hi: Brand, Audience, Niche, Traffic
Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline
Benefit, Action, Nurture, Trust
Business, Analytics, Network, Target
mr: Brand, Audience, Niche, Traffic
Budget, Authority, Need, Timeline
Benefit, Action, Nurture, Trust
Business, Analytics, Network, Target

exp.en: BANT checks whether a lead has the Budget, the Authority to decide, a real Need, and a Timeline to buy. It is a classic sales framework for deciding which leads to prioritise.
exp.hi: BANT check karta hai ki lead ke paas Budget hai, decide karne ki Authority hai, real Need hai aur khareedne ki Timeline hai. Yeh leads prioritise karne ka classic sales framework hai.
exp.mr: BANT तपासते की lead कडे Budget आहे का, निर्णय घेण्याची Authority आहे का, खरी Need आहे का आणि खरेदीची Timeline आहे का. Leads ना प्राधान्य देण्याचा हा classic sales framework आहे.

q.en: A fashion D2C blog gets 80,000 monthly visits from posts like 'Top 10 trends', but almost no sales. What is the best content change?
q.hi: Ek fashion D2C blog ko 'Top 10 trends' jaise posts se 80,000 monthly visits milte hain, par sales lagbhag zero. Best content change kya hai?
q.mr: एका fashion D2C blog ला 'Top 10 trends' सारख्या posts मधून महिन्याला 80,000 visits मिळतात, पण विक्री जवळजवळ शून्य आहे. सर्वोत्तम content बदल कोणता?

en: Publish twice as many trend posts to grow traffic further
Remove the blog completely and spend only on ads
Add pop-ups asking every visitor to buy immediately
Add MOFU/BOFU content like size guides linked to products
hi: Traffic aur badhane ke liye double trend posts publish karo
Blog poora hata do aur sirf ads par kharch karo
Har visitor ko turant khareedne ke pop-ups lagao
Products se linked size guides jaisa MOFU/BOFU content add karo
mr: Traffic आणखी वाढवण्यासाठी दुप्पट trend posts publish करा
Blog पूर्ण काढून फक्त ads वर खर्च करा
प्रत्येक visitor ला लगेच खरेदी करायला सांगणारे pop-ups लावा
Products शी जोडलेल्या size guides सारखे MOFU/BOFU content जोडा

exp.en: The blog only serves the top of the funnel. Content that helps buying decisions (fit guides, fabric comparisons, 'how to style this kurta') with internal links to products turns readers into buyers. More TOFU just adds more non-buying traffic.
exp.hi: Blog sirf funnel ke top ko serve kar raha hai. Buying decisions mein madad karne wala content (fit guides, fabric comparisons, 'yeh kurta kaise style karein') products ke internal links ke saath readers ko buyers banata hai. Aur TOFU se sirf non-buying traffic badhega.
exp.mr: Blog फक्त funnel च्या वरच्या भागाला सेवा देत आहे. खरेदीचा निर्णय घ्यायला मदत करणारे content (fit guides, fabric तुलना, 'हा कुर्ता कसा style करावा') products च्या internal links सह वाचकांना खरेदीदार बनवते. आणखी TOFU मुळे फक्त खरेदी न करणारे traffic वाढेल.

q.en: A Mumbai retailer's promotional SMS campaign for a Diwali sale fails to deliver to most numbers. What is the most likely cause in India?
q.hi: Mumbai ke ek retailer ka Diwali sale ka promotional SMS campaign zyada numbers par deliver nahi hua. India mein sabse likely cause kya hai?
q.mr: Mumbai मधील एका retailer ची Diwali sale ची promotional SMS campaign बहुतेक numbers वर पोहोचली नाही. भारतात सर्वात संभाव्य कारण कोणते?

en: Header or template not registered on TRAI's DLT platform
SMS containing the word 'Diwali' is blocked by operators
Promotional SMS is delivered only to Jio numbers
Promotional SMS must be written only in Hindi script
hi: Header ya template TRAI ke DLT platform par registered nahi
'Diwali' word wala SMS operators block kar dete hain
Promotional SMS sirf Jio numbers par deliver hota hai
Promotional SMS sirf Hindi script mein likhna zaroori hai
mr: Header किंवा template TRAI च्या DLT platform वर registered नाही
'Diwali' शब्द असलेले SMS operators block करतात
Promotional SMS फक्त Jio numbers वरच पोहोचतो
Promotional SMS फक्त हिंदी लिपीतच लिहावा लागतो

exp.en: Under TRAI's commercial-communication rules, businesses must register as an entity and register their headers and message templates on the DLT platform; unregistered content gets blocked. Promotional SMS also respects customers' DND preferences.
exp.hi: TRAI ke commercial-communication rules ke tahat business ko entity, headers aur message templates DLT platform par register karne padte hain; unregistered content block ho jaata hai. Promotional SMS customers ki DND preferences ka bhi dhyan rakhta hai.
exp.mr: TRAI च्या commercial-communication नियमांनुसार businesses नी entity, headers आणि message templates DLT platform वर register करणे आवश्यक आहे; unregistered content block होते. Promotional SMS ग्राहकांच्या DND प्राधान्यांचाही आदर करतो.

q.en: What is 'zero-party data'?
q.hi: 'Zero-party data' kya hota hai?
q.mr: 'Zero-party data' म्हणजे काय?

en: Data bought from a third-party data broker or list seller
Data collected by cookies without the user knowing
Data a customer intentionally shares, like quiz answers
Data that has been fully anonymised and deleted
hi: Third-party data broker ya list seller se khareeda data
User ke jaane bina cookies se collect hua data
Customer jaan-boojhkar share kiya data, jaise quiz answers
Poori tarah anonymise karke delete kiya gaya data
mr: Third-party data broker किंवा list विक्रेत्याकडून घेतलेला data
User ला न कळता cookies ने गोळा केलेला data
ग्राहकाने स्वतःहून दिलेला data, उदा. quiz उत्तरे
पूर्णपणे anonymise करून delete केलेला data

exp.en: Zero-party data is information customers proactively give you (skin type in a quiz, preferred language, sizes). It is accurate and consented, making it ideal for personalisation. First-party data is behaviour you observe on your own channels.
exp.hi: Zero-party data woh info hai jo customer khud deta hai (quiz mein skin type, preferred language, size). Yeh accurate aur consented hota hai, personalisation ke liye perfect. First-party data aapke channels par observe kiya behaviour hai.
exp.mr: Zero-party data म्हणजे ग्राहक स्वतःहून देतो ती माहिती (quiz मधील skin type, आवडती भाषा, size). ती अचूक आणि संमतीने मिळालेली असते, personalisation साठी उत्तम. First-party data म्हणजे तुमच्या channels वर पाहिलेले वर्तन.

q.en: A monthly subscription box finds that about a third of its churned customers left because their card payment failed, not by choice. Best tactic?
q.hi: Ek monthly subscription box ko pata chala ki churn hue lagbhag ek-tihai customers card payment fail hone se gaye, apni marzi se nahi. Best tactic?
q.mr: एका monthly subscription box ला कळले की गेलेल्या ग्राहकांपैकी सुमारे एक-तृतीयांश ग्राहक card payment fail झाल्यामुळे गेले, स्वतःच्या इच्छेने नाही. सर्वोत्तम उपाय?

en: Offer a flat 50% discount to every active subscriber now
Dunning: automatic payment retries plus card-update reminders
Run more Instagram ads to replace the lost customers
Send a survey asking churned customers why they cancelled
hi: Har active subscriber ko abhi flat 50% discount do
Dunning: automatic payment retries aur card-update reminders
Khoye customers replace karne ke liye aur Instagram ads chalao
Gaye customers se survey mein poochho ki cancel kyun kiya
mr: प्रत्येक सक्रिय subscriber ला आत्ता सरसकट 50% सवलत द्या
Dunning: automatic payment retries आणि card-update reminders
गेलेले ग्राहक भरून काढण्यासाठी आणखी Instagram ads चालवा
गेलेल्या ग्राहकांना survey मध्ये cancel का केले ते विचारा

exp.en: This is involuntary churn: customers didn't choose to leave. Dunning (automatic retries plus email/SMS/WhatsApp nudges to update the card or UPI mandate) recovers them cheaply. A 'why did you cancel' survey misses the point.
exp.hi: Yeh involuntary churn hai: customers ne jaana choose nahi kiya. Dunning (automatic retries aur card ya UPI mandate update karne ke email/SMS/WhatsApp nudges) unhe sasta wapas laata hai. 'Cancel kyun kiya' survey point miss karta hai.
exp.mr: हा involuntary churn आहे: ग्राहकांनी जाण्याचा निर्णय घेतला नाही. Dunning (automatic retries आणि card किंवा UPI mandate update करण्यासाठी email/SMS/WhatsApp nudges) त्यांना स्वस्तात परत आणते. 'का cancel केले' survey मूळ मुद्दा चुकवतो.

q.en: What does a DMARC policy of 'p=none' do?
q.hi: DMARC policy 'p=none' kya karti hai?
q.mr: DMARC policy 'p=none' काय करते?

en: Rejects every email that fails SPF or DKIM
Sends failing emails straight to the spam folder
Disables SPF and DKIM checks for the domain
Only monitors and reports; nothing is blocked
hi: SPF ya DKIM fail karne wala har email reject karti hai
Fail hone wale emails seedha spam folder mein bhejti hai
Domain ke liye SPF aur DKIM checks band kar deti hai
Sirf monitor aur report karti hai; kuch block nahi hota
mr: SPF किंवा DKIM fail होणारा प्रत्येक email reject करते
Fail होणारे emails थेट spam folder मध्ये पाठवते
Domain साठी SPF आणि DKIM checks बंद करते
फक्त monitor आणि report करते; काहीही block होत नाही

exp.en: p=none is monitoring mode: receivers send reports, but take no DMARC enforcement action. 'p=quarantine' sends failures to spam and 'p=reject' blocks them.
exp.hi: p=none monitoring mode hai: receivers reports bhejte hain par DMARC enforcement action nahi lete. 'p=quarantine' failures ko spam mein daalta hai aur 'p=reject' unhe block karta hai.
exp.mr: p=none म्हणजे monitoring mode: receivers reports पाठवतात पण DMARC enforcement कारवाई करत नाहीत. 'p=quarantine' fail झालेले mail spam मध्ये टाकते आणि 'p=reject' ते block करते.

q.en: What is a 'pristine spam trap'?
q.hi: 'Pristine spam trap' kya hota hai?
q.mr: 'Pristine spam trap' म्हणजे काय?

en: An address no real person ever used, set up to catch bought or scraped lists
An old customer address that hard-bounced once last year
A subscriber who opens every single email but never clicks
The Gmail folder where most promotional emails are filtered
hi: Aisa address jo kabhi kisi ne use nahi kiya, khareedi/scraped lists pakadne ke liye
Purane customer ka address jo pichhle saal ek baar hard-bounce hua
Subscriber jo har ek email kholta hai par kabhi click nahi karta
Gmail ka folder jahan zyada promotional emails filter hote hain
mr: कधीही कोणी न वापरलेला address, विकत/scraped lists पकडण्यासाठी तयार केलेला
जुन्या ग्राहकाचा address जो मागच्या वर्षी एकदा hard-bounce झाला
प्रत्येक email उघडणारा पण कधीच click न करणारा subscriber
Gmail चा folder जिथे बहुतेक promotional emails filter होतात

exp.en: Pristine traps are addresses that never signed up anywhere, often hidden on web pages. Hitting one proves you used scraped or purchased data and can get you blocklisted. Recycled traps, by contrast, are old abandoned addresses.
exp.hi: Pristine traps aise addresses hain jinhone kahin sign up nahi kiya, aksar web pages par chhupe hote hain. Inhe hit karna saabit karta hai ki aapne scraped ya khareeda data use kiya, aur blocklist ho sakte ho. Recycled traps purane abandoned addresses hote hain.
exp.mr: Pristine traps असे addresses असतात ज्यांनी कुठेही sign up केलेले नसते, अनेकदा web pages वर लपवलेले. त्यावर mail गेल्यास तुम्ही scraped किंवा विकत घेतलेला data वापरल्याचे सिद्ध होते आणि blocklist होऊ शकता. Recycled traps हे जुने सोडून दिलेले addresses असतात.

q.en: After more subscribers moved to iPhones, your email open rate jumped 25%, but clicks and revenue stayed flat. You were choosing A/B test winners by open rate. What now?
q.hi: Zyada subscribers iPhone par shift hue, open rate 25% badh gaya, par clicks aur revenue flat hain. Aap A/B test winners open rate se chun rahe the. Ab kya?
q.mr: अधिक subscribers iPhone वर गेल्यानंतर open rate 25% वाढला, पण clicks आणि revenue स्थिर आहेत. तुम्ही A/B test विजेते open rate वरून ठरवत होता. आता काय?

en: Celebrate: the subject lines are clearly working better
Send more emails per week since engagement is rising
Judge tests and health by clicks, conversions and revenue, not opens
Remove all iPhone users from the email list
hi: Celebrate karo: subject lines clearly better kaam kar rahi hain
Engagement badh raha hai, isliye har hafte zyada emails bhejo
Tests aur health ko opens ke bajaye clicks, conversions aur revenue se judge karo
Saare iPhone users ko email list se hata do
mr: उत्सव साजरा करा: subject lines स्पष्टपणे चांगल्या चालत आहेत
Engagement वाढत आहे म्हणून दर आठवड्याला जास्त emails पाठवा
Tests आणि आरोग्य opens ऐवजी clicks, conversions आणि revenue वरून तपासा
सर्व iPhone users ना email list मधून काढा

exp.en: Apple's Mail Privacy Protection can register machine 'opens', inflating open rates without real engagement. Flat clicks and revenue confirm it. Use clicks/conversions as the success metric, and treat open-based segments with caution.
exp.hi: Apple ka Mail Privacy Protection machine 'opens' record kar sakta hai, jisse bina real engagement ke open rate inflate hota hai. Flat clicks aur revenue yahi confirm karte hain. Success metric clicks/conversions rakho aur open-based segments ko dhyan se use karo.
exp.mr: Apple चे Mail Privacy Protection machine 'opens' नोंदवू शकते, त्यामुळे खऱ्या engagement शिवाय open rate फुगतो. स्थिर clicks आणि revenue हेच दाखवतात. यशाचा metric म्हणून clicks/conversions वापरा आणि open-based segments सावधपणे वापरा.

q.en: People who received your welcome email series bought 3x more than people who didn't. The CEO wants to credit the series with all that revenue. Your concern?
q.hi: Jin logon ko welcome email series mili unhone baaki logon se 3x zyada khareeda. CEO saara revenue series ko credit dena chahte hain. Aapki concern kya hai?
q.mr: ज्यांना welcome email series मिळाली त्यांनी इतरांपेक्षा 3 पट जास्त खरेदी केली. CEO ला सगळे revenue त्या series ला द्यायचे आहे. तुमची शंका काय?

en: The emails had too few images to really drive sales
Selection bias: measure true lift with a random holdout group
Open rate is a better success metric than revenue here
Welcome series are proven never to affect purchases
hi: Emails mein itni kam images thi ki sales nahi ho sakti
Selection bias: random holdout group se asli lift measure karo
Yahan revenue se behtar success metric open rate hai
Proven hai ki welcome series purchases par asar nahi karti
mr: Emails मध्ये इतक्या कमी images होत्या की विक्री होणे शक्य नाही
Selection bias: random holdout group ने खरी lift मोजा
इथे revenue पेक्षा open rate हा चांगला success metric आहे
Welcome series चा खरेदीवर परिणाम होत नाही हे सिद्ध आहे

exp.en: People who subscribe and receive welcome emails may already be more interested buyers. Only by randomly withholding the series from a small control group can you see the true incremental revenue it causes.
exp.hi: Jo log subscribe karke welcome emails paate hain, woh pehle se hi zyada interested buyers ho sakte hain. Ek chhote control group se series randomly rok kar hi aap asli incremental revenue dekh sakte ho.
exp.mr: जे लोक subscribe करून welcome emails मिळवतात ते आधीपासूनच जास्त इच्छुक खरेदीदार असू शकतात. एका छोट्या control group कडून series randomly रोखूनच तिचे खरे incremental revenue दिसू शकते.

q.en: Why do mature lead-scoring models apply 'score decay'?
q.hi: Mature lead-scoring models 'score decay' kyun lagate hain?
q.mr: प्रगत lead-scoring models 'score decay' का लावतात?

en: To punish leads who unsubscribe from emails
To make every lead reach MQL faster
To reduce the CRM's storage costs
So old engagement stops making inactive leads look hot
hi: Emails se unsubscribe karne wale leads ko punish karne ke liye
Har lead ko jaldi MQL banane ke liye
CRM ka storage cost kam karne ke liye
Taaki purana engagement inactive leads ko hot na dikhaye
mr: Emails मधून unsubscribe करणाऱ्या leads ना शिक्षा करण्यासाठी
प्रत्येक lead लवकर MQL व्हावी म्हणून
CRM चा storage खर्च कमी करण्यासाठी
जुन्या engagement मुळे निष्क्रिय leads 'hot' दिसू नयेत म्हणून

exp.en: A pricing-page visit from 8 months ago says little about intent today. Decay gradually lowers behavioural points over time, so sales focuses on leads that are engaged now.
exp.hi: 8 mahine purana pricing-page visit aaj ke intent ke baare mein kam batata hai. Decay time ke saath behavioural points dheere kam karta hai, taaki sales abhi engaged leads par focus kare.
exp.mr: 8 महिन्यांपूर्वीची pricing-page भेट आजच्या इच्छेबद्दल फारसे सांगत नाही. Decay कालांतराने behavioural points हळूहळू कमी करते, म्हणजे sales सध्या engaged असलेल्या leads वर लक्ष देते.

q.en: A customer's video showing a stale cake from your Mumbai outlet goes viral and outrage is growing on X and Instagram. What's the best move in the first hours?
q.hi: Aapke Mumbai outlet ke baasi cake ka customer video viral ho gaya aur X aur Instagram par gussa badh raha hai. Pehle kuch ghanton mein best move kya hai?
q.mr: तुमच्या Mumbai outlet मधील शिळ्या cake चा ग्राहकाचा video viral झाला आणि X व Instagram वर संताप वाढतोय. पहिल्या काही तासांत सर्वोत्तम पाऊल कोणते?

en: Acknowledge fast, investigate, act visibly and share updates
Stay silent and wait for the story to die down on its own
Delete critical comments and block the customer's account
Send the customer a legal notice for defamation right away
hi: Jaldi acknowledge karo, investigate karo, dikhne wala action lo, updates do
Chup raho aur story ke khud khatam hone ka wait karo
Critical comments delete karo aur customer ka account block karo
Customer ko turant defamation ka legal notice bhejo
mr: लवकर मान्य करा, चौकशी करा, दिसेल अशी कारवाई करा, updates द्या
गप्प राहा आणि बातमी आपोआप शांत होण्याची वाट पाहा
टीकात्मक comments delete करा आणि ग्राहकाचे account block करा
ग्राहकाला लगेच मानहानीची legal notice पाठवा

exp.en: In a crisis, silence lets others write your story, and deleting or threatening usually amplifies it. A fast, human acknowledgement, a clear corrective action (e.g., checking stock, contacting the customer) and follow-up updates rebuild trust.
exp.hi: Crisis mein chup rehne se doosre aapki story likhte hain, aur delete ya dhamki dene se baat aur failti hai. Tez, insaani acknowledgement, clear corrective action (jaise stock check, customer se contact) aur follow-up updates trust wapas laate hain.
exp.mr: संकटात गप्प राहिल्यास इतर लोक तुमची कथा लिहितात, आणि delete किंवा धमकी दिल्यास प्रकरण आणखी पसरते. जलद, माणुसकीची कबुली, स्पष्ट सुधारात्मक कारवाई (उदा. stock तपासणे, ग्राहकाशी संपर्क) आणि पुढील updates विश्वास परत मिळवतात.

q.en: Your brand's WhatsApp marketing templates are being blocked and reported by many users, and your phone number's quality rating has dropped. What should you do?
q.hi: Aapke brand ke WhatsApp marketing templates ko bahut users block aur report kar rahe hain, aur number ki quality rating gir gayi hai. Kya karna chahiye?
q.mr: तुमच्या brand चे WhatsApp marketing templates अनेक users block आणि report करत आहेत, आणि number ची quality rating घसरली आहे. काय करावे?

en: Switch to a new phone number and resend the same messages
Increase frequency so the brand stays top of mind
Cut frequency; message only relevant opted-in segments
Add more emojis and bold text to the templates
hi: Naya phone number lo aur wahi messages dobara bhejo
Frequency badhao taaki brand top of mind rahe
Frequency kam karo; sirf relevant opted-in segments ko bhejo
Templates mein aur emojis aur bold text daalo
mr: नवीन phone number घेऊन तेच messages पुन्हा पाठवा
Brand लक्षात राहावा म्हणून frequency वाढवा
Frequency कमी करा; फक्त relevant opt-in segments ना पाठवा
Templates मध्ये आणखी emojis आणि bold text टाका

exp.en: Blocks and reports signal unwanted messages and lower your quality rating, which can restrict your messaging. Fewer, more relevant messages to people who asked for them, with an easy way out, fix the cause. A new number just repeats the problem.
exp.hi: Blocks aur reports unwanted messages ka signal hain aur quality rating girate hain, jisse messaging restrict ho sakti hai. Maangne walon ko kam aur zyada relevant messages, easy opt-out ke saath, asli cause theek karte hain. Naya number sirf problem repeat karega.
exp.mr: Blocks आणि reports हे नको असलेल्या messages चे संकेत आहेत आणि quality rating कमी करतात, त्यामुळे messaging मर्यादित होऊ शकते. मागणाऱ्यांनाच कमी पण अधिक relevant messages, सोप्या opt-out सह, हे मूळ कारण दूर करतात. नवीन number ने फक्त समस्या पुन्हा होईल.

q.en: To show your brand logo in supporting inboxes via BIMI, which email authentication condition must be met?
q.hi: BIMI se supporting inboxes mein brand logo dikhane ke liye kaunsi email authentication condition zaroori hai?
q.mr: BIMI द्वारे supporting inboxes मध्ये brand logo दाखवण्यासाठी कोणती email authentication अट आवश्यक आहे?

en: SPF alone with a '~all' soft-fail record
DMARC at enforcement: p=quarantine or p=reject
A DMARC policy of p=none for monitoring
A dedicated IP address with 100% open rate
hi: Sirf SPF, '~all' soft-fail record ke saath
DMARC enforcement par: p=quarantine ya p=reject
Monitoring ke liye DMARC policy p=none
100% open rate wala dedicated IP address
mr: फक्त SPF, '~all' soft-fail record सह
DMARC enforcement वर: p=quarantine किंवा p=reject
Monitoring साठी DMARC policy p=none
100% open rate असलेला dedicated IP address

exp.en: BIMI requires DMARC at an enforcement policy (quarantine or reject); p=none is not enough. Some inboxes such as Gmail also require a verified mark certificate for the logo.
exp.hi: BIMI ke liye DMARC enforcement policy (quarantine ya reject) par hona chahiye; p=none kaafi nahi hai. Gmail jaise kuch inboxes logo ke liye verified mark certificate bhi maangte hain.
exp.mr: BIMI साठी DMARC enforcement policy (quarantine किंवा reject) वर असणे आवश्यक आहे; p=none पुरेसे नाही. Gmail सारखे काही inboxes logo साठी verified mark certificate सुद्धा मागतात.

q.en: In reputation management, what is the 'Streisand effect'?
q.hi: Reputation management mein 'Streisand effect' kya hai?
q.mr: Reputation management मध्ये 'Streisand effect' म्हणजे काय?

en: Celebrity endorsements always improve brand trust
Negative reviews disappear automatically after a year
Positive press releases rank above news articles
Trying to suppress information ends up spreading it further
hi: Celebrity endorsements hamesha brand trust badhate hain
Negative reviews ek saal baad khud gayab ho jaate hain
Positive press releases news articles se upar rank karti hain
Kisi info ko dabane ki koshish use aur zyada faila deti hai
mr: Celebrity endorsements नेहमी brand वरचा विश्वास वाढवतात
Negative reviews एका वर्षानंतर आपोआप नाहीशी होतात
Positive press releases news articles पेक्षा वर rank होतात
एखादी माहिती दडपण्याचा प्रयत्न ती आणखी पसरवतो

exp.en: Named after a 2003 case where Barbra Streisand's attempt to suppress a photo of her house made it far more famous. Heavy-handed takedowns or legal threats against critics often go viral themselves.
exp.hi: Yeh naam 2003 ke case se aaya jab Barbra Streisand ne apne ghar ki photo dabane ki koshish ki aur woh aur famous ho gayi. Critics par heavy takedowns ya legal dhamkiyan aksar khud viral ho jaati hain.
exp.mr: हे नाव 2003 च्या प्रकरणावरून आले, जेव्हा Barbra Streisand ने आपल्या घराचा फोटो दडपण्याचा प्रयत्न केला आणि तो जास्तच प्रसिद्ध झाला. टीकाकारांवर कठोर takedowns किंवा कायदेशीर धमक्या अनेकदा स्वतःच viral होतात.

q.en: In your B2B HR-software CRM, students and competitors who download many e-books are reaching MQL status because they score high on engagement. Best fix?
q.hi: Aapke B2B HR-software CRM mein students aur competitors bahut e-books download karke MQL ban rahe hain kyunki engagement score high hai. Best fix?
q.mr: तुमच्या B2B HR-software CRM मध्ये बरीच e-books download करणारे students आणि स्पर्धक engagement score जास्त असल्याने MQL होत आहेत. सर्वोत्तम उपाय?

en: Score fit and engagement separately, with negative points for bad fit
Stop offering e-books so nobody can download them anymore
Raise the MQL threshold so only about 5 leads qualify each month
Give every e-book download zero points in the scoring model
hi: Fit aur engagement alag score karo, bad fit par negative points
E-books dena band karo taaki koi download hi na kar sake
MQL threshold itna badhao ki mahine mein sirf ~5 leads qualify hon
Scoring model mein har e-book download ko zero points do
mr: Fit आणि engagement वेगळे score करा, bad fit साठी negative points
E-books देणे बंद करा म्हणजे कोणी download करूच शकणार नाही
MQL threshold इतका वाढवा की महिन्याला ~5 leads च qualify होतील
Scoring model मध्ये प्रत्येक e-book download ला शून्य points द्या

exp.en: Engagement alone can't tell a curious student from a buyer. A two-axis model (fit × engagement) with negative scoring for bad-fit signals keeps active but unqualified people out, without killing useful content.
exp.hi: Sirf engagement se curious student aur buyer mein farak nahi pata chalta. Two-axis model (fit × engagement) aur bad-fit signals par negative scoring active par unqualified logon ko bahar rakhta hai, useful content band kiye bina.
exp.mr: फक्त engagement वरून उत्सुक student आणि खरेदीदार यांतील फरक कळत नाही. Two-axis model (fit × engagement) आणि bad-fit संकेतांसाठी negative scoring सक्रिय पण अपात्र लोकांना बाहेर ठेवते, उपयुक्त content बंद न करता.

q.en: A small brand sends about 20,000 emails a month and has inbox-placement issues. The team wants to buy a dedicated IP to fix it. Your advice?
q.hi: Ek chhota brand mahine mein lagbhag 20,000 emails bhejta hai aur inbox placement problems hain. Team fix ke liye dedicated IP khareedna chahti hai. Aapki advice?
q.mr: एक छोटा brand महिन्याला सुमारे 20,000 emails पाठवतो आणि inbox placement च्या अडचणी आहेत. Team ला उपाय म्हणून dedicated IP घ्यायचा आहे. तुमचा सल्ला?

en: Yes, a dedicated IP will instantly guarantee inbox placement
Yes, and mail the full list daily to warm the new IP faster
Probably not: volume is too low; fix auth, hygiene and engagement first
