No, send from a free Gmail account instead to look personal
hi: Haan, dedicated IP turant inbox placement guarantee kar dega
Haan, aur naya IP jaldi warm karne ke liye roz poori list ko bhejo
Shayad nahi: volume kam hai; pehle auth, hygiene aur engagement sudharo
Nahi, personal dikhne ke liye free Gmail account se bhejo
mr: हो, dedicated IP लगेच inbox placement ची खात्री देईल
हो, आणि नवीन IP लवकर warm करण्यासाठी रोज संपूर्ण list ला पाठवा
बहुधा नाही: volume कमी आहे; आधी auth, hygiene आणि engagement सुधारा
नाही, personal वाटावे म्हणून free Gmail account वरून पाठवा

exp.en: A dedicated IP needs steady, meaningful volume to build and keep a reputation; at low volume it can perform worse than a well-managed shared IP. Most placement issues come from authentication, list quality and low engagement.
exp.hi: Dedicated IP ko reputation banane aur banaye rakhne ke liye steady, achha volume chahiye; kam volume par yeh achhe managed shared IP se bhi bura perform kar sakta hai. Zyada placement issues authentication, list quality aur low engagement se aate hain.
exp.mr: Dedicated IP ला reputation बनवण्यासाठी आणि टिकवण्यासाठी सातत्यपूर्ण, पुरेसा volume लागतो; कमी volume वर तो चांगल्या managed shared IP पेक्षाही वाईट चालू शकतो. बहुतेक placement अडचणी authentication, list quality आणि कमी engagement मुळे येतात.

q.en: A café chain's points programme: members just redeem points as discounts, margins are shrinking, and visit frequency hasn't changed versus non-members. Best redesign?
q.hi: Ek café chain ka points programme: members sirf points ko discount mein redeem karte hain, margins ghat rahe hain, aur non-members ke comparison mein visit frequency nahi badhi. Best redesign?
q.mr: एका café chain चा points programme: सदस्य फक्त points सवलतीत redeem करतात, margins कमी होत आहेत आणि non-members च्या तुलनेत भेटींची वारंवारता बदललेली नाही. सर्वोत्तम redesign?

en: Double the points earned per rupee to excite existing members
Shut the programme down and move the whole budget into ads
Replace points with the same flat 20% discount for every member
Add behaviour-based tiers and non-discount perks, tested vs a control
hi: Existing members ko excite karne ke liye har rupee par double points
Programme band karo aur poora budget ads mein daal do
Points hatao aur har member ko same flat 20% discount do
Behaviour-based tiers aur non-discount perks, control group se test karke
mr: सध्याच्या सदस्यांना उत्साहित करण्यासाठी प्रत्येक रुपयावर दुप्पट points
Programme बंद करून संपूर्ण budget ads कडे वळवा
Points काढून प्रत्येक सदस्याला सरसकट 20% सवलत द्या
वर्तनावर आधारित tiers आणि सवलतीशिवायचे perks, control group सोबत test करून

exp.en: The programme is subsidising purchases that would happen anyway. Tiers that reward the behaviour you want (e.g., more visits) plus experiential perks (early menu tastings, free upgrades) cost less than discounts, and a control group shows if behaviour really changes.
exp.hi: Programme un purchases ko subsidise kar raha hai jo waise bhi hote. Chahe gaye behaviour (jaise zyada visits) ko reward karne wale tiers aur experiential perks (early menu tasting, free upgrade) discount se saste hain, aur control group batata hai ki behaviour sach mein badla ya nahi.
exp.mr: Programme अशा खरेदीला अनुदान देत आहे जी तशीही झाली असती. हव्या असलेल्या वर्तनाला (उदा. जास्त भेटी) reward देणारे tiers आणि अनुभवात्मक perks (नवीन menu चाखणे, free upgrade) सवलतीपेक्षा स्वस्त पडतात, आणि control group दाखवतो की वर्तन खरोखर बदलले का.

q.en: Using Eugene Schwartz's 'stages of awareness', what copy approach suits a 'most aware' prospect who knows your product and wants it?
q.hi: Eugene Schwartz ke 'stages of awareness' ke hisaab se 'most aware' prospect (jo product jaanta hai aur chahta hai) ke liye kaunsa copy approach sahi hai?
q.mr: Eugene Schwartz च्या 'stages of awareness' नुसार 'most aware' prospect (ज्याला product माहीत आहे आणि हवा आहे) साठी कोणता copy approach योग्य?

en: A long story that slowly introduces the problem
Lead straight with the offer: price, deal and a clear CTA
Educational content explaining that the problem exists
A teaser ad that hides the product name
hi: Lambi story jo dheere se problem introduce kare
Seedha offer se shuru karo: price, deal aur clear CTA
Educational content jo bataye ki problem exist karti hai
Teaser ad jo product ka naam chhupaaye
mr: हळूहळू समस्या मांडणारी लांब कथा
थेट offer ने सुरुवात: किंमत, deal आणि स्पष्ट CTA
समस्या अस्तित्वात आहे हे समजावणारे educational content
Product चे नाव लपवणारी teaser ad

exp.en: The more aware the prospect, the more direct the copy should be. 'Most aware' buyers only need the deal and a reason to act now; problem-education is for unaware or problem-aware audiences.
exp.hi: Prospect jitna zyada aware, copy utni hi direct honi chahiye. 'Most aware' buyers ko sirf deal aur abhi act karne ki wajah chahiye; problem-education unaware ya problem-aware audience ke liye hai.
exp.mr: Prospect जितका जास्त aware, copy तितकी थेट असावी. 'Most aware' खरेदीदारांना फक्त deal आणि आत्ता कृती करण्याचे कारण हवे असते; समस्येचे शिक्षण unaware किंवा problem-aware audience साठी असते.

q.en: A coaching institute sends the same 10-email nurture sequence to every lead, whether they want JEE, NEET or MPSC coaching. Unsubscribes are high. Best fix?
q.hi: Ek coaching institute har lead ko same 10-email nurture sequence bhejta hai, chahe use JEE, NEET ya MPSC coaching chahiye. Unsubscribes high hain. Best fix?
q.mr: एक coaching institute प्रत्येक lead ला एकच 10-email nurture sequence पाठवते, मग त्याला JEE, NEET किंवा MPSC coaching हवे असो. Unsubscribes जास्त आहेत. सर्वोत्तम उपाय?

en: Branch by exam interest and stage, with exit rules after booking
Cut the sequence down to a single email for everyone
Send all 10 emails on the same day so the sequence ends faster
Remove the unsubscribe link from all nurture emails
hi: Exam interest aur stage se branch karo, booking ke baad exit rules
Sabke liye sequence ko sirf ek email tak kaat do
Saare 10 emails ek hi din bhejo taaki sequence jaldi khatam ho
Saare nurture emails se unsubscribe link hata do
mr: Exam आवड आणि टप्प्यानुसार branch करा, booking नंतर exit नियम
सर्वांसाठी sequence फक्त एका email पर्यंत कमी करा
Sequence लवकर संपावी म्हणून सर्व 10 emails एकाच दिवशी पाठवा
सर्व nurture emails मधून unsubscribe link काढा

exp.en: Irrelevant content drives unsubscribes. Branching by declared interest (JEE/NEET/MPSC) and behaviour, plus goal/exit criteria so converted leads stop getting nurture emails, makes every message relevant. Removing unsubscribe links breaks the law and inbox rules.
exp.hi: Irrelevant content se unsubscribes badhte hain. Declared interest (JEE/NEET/MPSC) aur behaviour se branching, aur goal/exit criteria taaki convert hue leads ko nurture emails na jaayein, har message relevant banata hai. Unsubscribe link hatana law aur inbox rules todta hai.
exp.mr: Irrelevant content मुळे unsubscribes वाढतात. सांगितलेल्या आवडीनुसार (JEE/NEET/MPSC) आणि वर्तनानुसार branching, तसेच convert झालेल्या leads ना nurture emails थांबवणारे goal/exit निकष, प्रत्येक message relevant करतात. Unsubscribe link काढणे कायदा आणि inbox नियम मोडते.

q.en: A D2C protein brand has a 12% repeat-purchase rate while CAC keeps rising. The CEO's plan is to double ad spend. What's the smarter strategic move?
q.hi: Ek D2C protein brand ka repeat-purchase rate 12% hai aur CAC badhta ja raha hai. CEO ad spend double karna chahte hain. Zyada smart strategic move kya hai?
q.mr: एका D2C protein brand चा repeat-purchase rate 12% आहे आणि CAC सतत वाढत आहे. CEO ला ad spend दुप्पट करायचा आहे. अधिक हुशार strategic पाऊल कोणते?

en: Double ad spend, but concentrate it on just one platform
Cut prices by 30% to win many more first-time orders
Fix retention first: onboarding, refill reminders, loyalty, referral
Pause all marketing until the repeat rate improves by itself
hi: Ad spend double karo, par sirf ek platform par focus karo
Kaafi zyada first-time orders ke liye price 30% kam karo
Pehle retention sudharo: onboarding, refill reminders, loyalty, referral
Repeat rate khud sudhre tab tak saari marketing rok do
mr: Ad spend दुप्पट करा, पण फक्त एका platform वर केंद्रित करा
खूप जास्त पहिल्या orders साठी किंमत 30% कमी करा
आधी retention सुधारा: onboarding, refill reminders, loyalty, referral
Repeat rate आपोआप सुधारेपर्यंत सगळे marketing थांबवा

exp.en: With low repeat rates, each costlier new customer is worth little, so doubling spend scales a leaky bucket. Raising LTV through well-timed replenishment reminders (a 1 kg tub lasts roughly a month), onboarding and referrals makes higher CAC affordable. Track it with cohorts.
exp.hi: Low repeat rate mein har mehenga naya customer kam value deta hai, isliye spend double karna leaky bucket ko scale karna hai. Sahi time par refill reminders (1 kg tub lagbhag ek mahina chalta hai), onboarding aur referrals se LTV badhta hai aur zyada CAC afford hota hai. Cohorts se track karo.
exp.mr: Repeat rate कमी असताना प्रत्येक महागडा नवीन ग्राहक कमी मूल्य देतो, म्हणून खर्च दुप्पट करणे म्हणजे गळक्या बादलीत पाणी ओतणे. योग्य वेळी refill reminders (1 kg tub साधारण महिनाभर पुरतो), onboarding आणि referrals मुळे LTV वाढतो आणि जास्त CAC परवडतो. Cohorts ने track करा.

q.en: IT moved your domain's DMARC straight from nothing to p=reject. Now invoices sent by your third-party billing tool are being rejected. What's the right rollout?
q.hi: IT ne domain ka DMARC seedha kuch nahi se p=reject kar diya. Ab third-party billing tool se jaane wale invoices reject ho rahe hain. Sahi rollout kya hai?
q.mr: IT ने domain चा DMARC थेट काहीच नाही वरून p=reject केला. आता third-party billing tool मधून जाणारे invoices reject होत आहेत. योग्य rollout कोणता?

en: Keep p=reject and ask customers to check their spam folders
Start at p=none, find all senders via reports, align, then tighten
Delete the DMARC record permanently to stop the rejections
Send invoices from staff members' personal Gmail accounts
hi: p=reject rakho aur customers se spam folder check karne ko kaho
p=none se shuru karo, reports se saare senders dhoondo, align karo, phir tight karo
Rejections rokne ke liye DMARC record hamesha ke liye delete karo
Invoices staff ke personal Gmail accounts se bhejo
mr: p=reject ठेवा आणि ग्राहकांना spam folder तपासायला सांगा
p=none पासून सुरुवात, reports मधून सर्व senders शोधा, align करा, मग कडक करा
Rejections थांबवण्यासाठी DMARC record कायमचा delete करा
Invoices staff च्या personal Gmail accounts वरून पाठवा

exp.en: DMARC should be phased: monitor with p=none, read aggregate (rua) reports to discover every legitimate sender (CRM, billing, helpdesk), authenticate and align them, then tighten to quarantine and finally reject.
exp.hi: DMARC phases mein lagta hai: p=none se monitor karo, aggregate (rua) reports padhkar har legitimate sender (CRM, billing, helpdesk) dhoondo, unhe authenticate aur align karo, phir quarantine aur aakhir mein reject karo.
exp.mr: DMARC टप्प्याटप्प्याने लावावे: p=none ने monitor करा, aggregate (rua) reports वाचून प्रत्येक वैध sender (CRM, billing, helpdesk) शोधा, त्यांना authenticate आणि align करा, मग quarantine आणि शेवटी reject करा.

q.en: Your CRM credits every B2B deal to the last touch, 'Demo request form', so leadership plans to cut the content budget, even though prospects often mention your webinars. What's the best case to make?
q.hi: Aapka CRM har B2B deal ko last touch 'Demo request form' ko credit karta hai, isliye leadership content budget kaatna chahti hai, jabki prospects aksar aapke webinars ka zikr karte hain. Sabse achha argument kya hai?
q.mr: तुमचे CRM प्रत्येक B2B deal चे श्रेय last touch 'Demo request form' ला देते, म्हणून leadership content budget कापणार आहे, जरी prospects अनेकदा तुमच्या webinars चा उल्लेख करतात. सर्वोत्तम युक्तिवाद कोणता?

en: Show multi-touch influence reports and 'How did you hear about us?' data
Argue that content should simply never be measured at all
Ask sales to manually tag every closed deal as 'content'
Switch to first-touch attribution only and ignore demo forms
hi: Multi-touch influence reports aur 'Humare baare mein kaise suna?' data dikhao
Kaho ki content ko kabhi measure hi nahi karna chahiye
Sales se har closed deal ko manually 'content' tag karwao
Sirf first-touch attribution par jao aur demo forms ignore karo
mr: Multi-touch influence reports आणि 'आमच्याबद्दल कसे कळले?' data दाखवा
Content कधीच मोजूच नये असा युक्तिवाद करा
Sales कडून प्रत्येक closed deal ला manually 'content' tag करून घ्या
फक्त first-touch attribution वापरा आणि demo forms कडे दुर्लक्ष करा

exp.en: Last-touch hides everything that created demand before the form fill. Showing how many won deals touched content along the way, backed by what buyers themselves say, gives a fair, balanced view. Swapping to first-touch just moves the bias.
exp.hi: Last-touch form fill se pehle demand banane wali har cheez chhupa deta hai. Kitne won deals ne raaste mein content touch kiya, aur buyers khud kya kehte hain, yeh dikhane se fair, balanced view milta hai. First-touch par jaana sirf bias shift karta hai.
exp.mr: Last-touch हे form fill पूर्वी मागणी निर्माण करणारे सर्व काही लपवते. जिंकलेल्या किती deals नी वाटेत content ला स्पर्श केला आणि खरेदीदार स्वतः काय सांगतात हे दाखवल्यास न्याय्य, संतुलित चित्र मिळते. First-touch वर जाणे फक्त bias बदलते.

q.en: A 30-year-old Kolhapuri chappal brand is seen as 'cheap tourist footwear' and wants premium positioning. What approach will actually work?
q.hi: 30 saal purana Kolhapuri chappal brand 'saste tourist footwear' ki tarah dekha jaata hai aur premium positioning chahta hai. Kaunsa approach sach mein kaam karega?
q.mr: 30 वर्षे जुना Kolhapuri चप्पल brand 'स्वस्त पर्यटक footwear' म्हणून ओळखला जातो आणि त्याला premium positioning हवे आहे. कोणता मार्ग खरोखर यशस्वी होईल?

en: Change only the logo and colours and keep everything else
Run heavy discounts to attract more premium-minded buyers
Add the word 'premium' to every ad without other changes
Align product, craft story, pricing, packaging and distribution to premium
hi: Sirf logo aur colours badlo, baaki sab waisa hi rakho
Premium soch wale buyers laane ke liye heavy discounts chalao
Baaki kuch badle bina har ad mein 'premium' word jodo
Product, craft story, pricing, packaging aur distribution ko premium se align karo
mr: फक्त logo आणि रंग बदला, बाकी सगळे तसेच ठेवा
Premium विचारांचे खरेदीदार आणण्यासाठी मोठ्या सवलती द्या
इतर काहीही न बदलता प्रत्येक ad मध्ये 'premium' शब्द जोडा
Product, कारागिरीची कथा, pricing, packaging आणि distribution premium शी जुळवा

exp.en: Positioning lives in customers' minds and is shaped by every touchpoint. A new logo or 'premium' claims can't beat cheap-feeling products, discounts or roadside distribution. Proof across product, story, price and place is what shifts perception.
exp.hi: Positioning customers ke mind mein hoti hai aur har touchpoint se banti hai. Naya logo ya 'premium' claims saste lagne wale product, discounts ya roadside distribution ko nahi hara sakte. Product, story, price aur place par proof hi perception badalta hai.
exp.mr: Positioning ग्राहकांच्या मनात असते आणि प्रत्येक touchpoint ने घडते. नवीन logo किंवा 'premium' दावे स्वस्त वाटणारे product, सवलती किंवा रस्त्याकडेचे distribution हरवू शकत नाहीत. Product, कथा, किंमत आणि ठिकाण यांतील पुरावाच धारणा बदलतो.

q.en: Why is 'review gating' (asking only happy customers for Google reviews and steering unhappy ones elsewhere) a bad idea?
q.hi: 'Review gating' (sirf khush customers se Google review maangna aur naraz walon ko kahin aur bhejna) kharab idea kyun hai?
q.mr: 'Review gating' (फक्त समाधानी ग्राहकांकडून Google reviews मागणे आणि नाराजांना दुसरीकडे वळवणे) ही वाईट कल्पना का आहे?

en: It makes the average rating fall below 3 stars
Google only counts reviews written in English
It breaks Google's review policies and misleads customers
Unhappy customers can't legally post online reviews
hi: Isse average rating 3 stars se neeche gir jaati hai
Google sirf English reviews ginta hai
Yeh Google ki review policies todta hai aur customers ko mislead karta hai
Naraz customers legally online review post nahi kar sakte
mr: त्यामुळे सरासरी rating 3 stars च्या खाली जाते
Google फक्त English मधील reviews मोजते
हे Google च्या review policies मोडते आणि ग्राहकांची दिशाभूल करते
नाराज ग्राहक कायदेशीररित्या online review देऊ शकत नाहीत

exp.en: Google's policies prohibit selectively soliciting positive reviews or discouraging negative ones; violating reviews can be removed. Ask all customers for honest reviews and handle complaints separately.
exp.hi: Google policies selectively positive reviews maangna ya negative reviews ko rokna mana karti hain; aise reviews hataye ja sakte hain. Sabhi customers se honest review maango aur complaints alag se handle karo.
exp.mr: Google च्या policies निवडकपणे सकारात्मक reviews मागणे किंवा नकारात्मक reviews रोखणे यावर बंदी घालतात; असे reviews काढले जाऊ शकतात. सर्व ग्राहकांकडून प्रामाणिक reviews मागा आणि तक्रारी वेगळ्या हाताळा.

q.en: A subscription business reports Net Revenue Retention (NRR) of 115%. What does this mean?
q.hi: Ek subscription business ka Net Revenue Retention (NRR) 115% hai. Iska matlab kya hai?
q.mr: एका subscription business चा Net Revenue Retention (NRR) 115% आहे. याचा अर्थ काय?

en: It won 15% more new customers than it did last year
Upsells from existing customers outweighed churn and downgrades
115% of its customers renewed their plans this year
Its marketing spend came in 15% below the budget
hi: Pichhle saal se 15% zyada naye customers jeete
Existing customers ke upsells churn aur downgrades se zyada rahe
Is saal 115% customers ne apne plans renew kiye
Marketing spend budget se 15% kam raha
mr: मागील वर्षापेक्षा 15% जास्त नवीन ग्राहक मिळाले
सध्याच्या ग्राहकांचे upsells churn आणि downgrades पेक्षा जास्त राहिले
या वर्षी 115% ग्राहकांनी त्यांचे plans renew केले
Marketing खर्च budget पेक्षा 15% कमी राहिला

exp.en: NRR looks only at revenue from an existing customer cohort: starting revenue + expansion − churn − downgrades, divided by starting revenue. Above 100% means the base grows even with zero new customers. New-customer revenue is excluded.
exp.hi: NRR sirf existing customer cohort ka revenue dekhta hai: starting revenue + expansion − churn − downgrades, divided by starting revenue. 100% se upar matlab bina naye customers ke bhi base badh raha hai. Naye customers ka revenue isme nahi gina jaata.
exp.mr: NRR फक्त सध्याच्या ग्राहक cohort चे revenue पाहतो: सुरुवातीचे revenue + expansion − churn − downgrades, भागिले सुरुवातीचे revenue. 100% पेक्षा जास्त म्हणजे नवीन ग्राहक नसतानाही base वाढत आहे. नवीन ग्राहकांचे revenue यात मोजले जात नाही.

q.en: A news site publishes an article about your hospital chain with a clear factual error about your pricing. What is the best PR response?
q.hi: Ek news site ne aapki hospital chain par article chhapa jismein pricing ke baare mein clear factual error hai. Best PR response kya hai?
q.mr: एका news site ने तुमच्या hospital chain बद्दल लेख छापला ज्यात pricing बद्दल स्पष्ट तथ्यात्मक चूक आहे. सर्वोत्तम PR प्रतिसाद कोणता?

en: Privately send the editor evidence and request a correction
Post an angry thread attacking the journalist by name
Threaten the publication with a lawsuit on social media
Buy ads on the same site so the article gets removed
hi: Editor ko privately evidence bhejo aur correction maango
Journalist ka naam lekar gusse wala thread post karo
Social media par publication ko lawsuit ki dhamki do
Usi site par ads khareedo taaki article hat jaaye
mr: Editor ला खाजगीत पुरावा पाठवा आणि दुरुस्ती मागा
पत्रकाराचे नाव घेऊन रागाने thread post करा
Social media वर publication ला खटल्याची धमकी द्या
त्याच site वर ads विकत घ्या म्हणजे लेख काढला जाईल

exp.en: Most publications correct genuine factual errors when shown evidence calmly. You can also share a brief factual clarification on your own channels. Public attacks and threats damage media relationships and can amplify the story.
exp.hi: Zyada publications genuine factual errors calmly evidence dikhane par correct kar deti hain. Aap apne channels par short factual clarification bhi de sakte ho. Public attacks aur dhamkiyan media relations bigaadti hain aur story ko aur failaa sakti hain.
exp.mr: बहुतेक publications शांतपणे पुरावा दाखवल्यास खऱ्या तथ्यात्मक चुका दुरुस्त करतात. तुम्ही स्वतःच्या channels वर थोडक्यात तथ्यात्मक स्पष्टीकरणही देऊ शकता. सार्वजनिक हल्ले आणि धमक्या media संबंध बिघडवतात आणि बातमी आणखी पसरवू शकतात.

q.en: Your abandoned-cart flow sends email, SMS and WhatsApp at the same moment, and still sends reminders after customers have bought. Complaints are rising. Best fix?
q.hi: Aapka abandoned-cart flow email, SMS aur WhatsApp ek hi time par bhejta hai, aur khareedne ke baad bhi reminders bhejta rehta hai. Complaints badh rahi hain. Best fix?
q.mr: तुमचा abandoned-cart flow email, SMS आणि WhatsApp एकाच वेळी पाठवतो, आणि खरेदीनंतरही reminders पाठवत राहतो. तक्रारी वाढत आहेत. सर्वोत्तम उपाय?

en: Turn off email and keep only SMS for every customer
Add a bigger discount to every reminder in the flow
Send the reminders only on weekends, when people shop
One journey: consented channel first, caps, stop on purchase
hi: Email band karo aur har customer ke liye sirf SMS rakho
Flow ke har reminder mein bada discount daalo
Reminders sirf weekends par bhejo, jab log shopping karte hain
Ek journey: pehle consented channel, caps, purchase par stop
mr: Email बंद करा आणि प्रत्येक ग्राहकासाठी फक्त SMS ठेवा
Flow मधील प्रत्येक reminder मध्ये मोठी सवलत द्या
लोक shopping करतात तेव्हा, फक्त weekends ला reminders पाठवा
एकच journey: आधी संमतीचा channel, caps, खरेदीनंतर थांबवा

exp.en: Channels should work as one sequence, not three parallel blasts: start with the customer's preferred/consented channel, escalate only if there's no response, cap total touches, and exit the flow the moment they purchase on any channel.
exp.hi: Channels ek sequence ki tarah kaam karein, teen parallel blasts ki tarah nahi: customer ke preferred/consented channel se shuru karo, response na aaye tabhi aage badho, total touches cap karo, aur kisi bhi channel par purchase hote hi flow se exit karo.
exp.mr: Channels नी तीन समांतर blasts नव्हे तर एकाच sequence सारखे काम करावे: ग्राहकाच्या आवडीच्या/संमती दिलेल्या channel ने सुरुवात करा, प्रतिसाद नसेल तरच पुढे जा, एकूण touches मर्यादित ठेवा आणि कोणत्याही channel वर खरेदी होताच flow मधून बाहेर काढा.

q.en: A B2B SaaS team gated every blog and guide behind forms. MQLs rose 80%, but SQLs and pipeline stayed flat and sales morale is falling. What's the right strategic call?
q.hi: Ek B2B SaaS team ne har blog aur guide ko form ke peeche gate kar diya. MQLs 80% badhe, par SQLs aur pipeline flat rahe aur sales ka morale gir raha hai. Sahi strategic call kya hai?
q.mr: एका B2B SaaS team ने प्रत्येक blog आणि guide form मागे gate केले. MQLs 80% वाढल्या, पण SQLs आणि pipeline स्थिर राहिल्या आणि sales चे मनोबल घसरत आहे. योग्य strategic निर्णय कोणता?

en: Gate even more content to push MQLs up another 80%
Keep everything gated but lower the MQL score threshold
Judge by pipeline; ungate TOFU, keep high-intent offers gated
Stop producing content and move the budget to cold calling
hi: Aur content gate karo taaki MQLs 80% aur badhein
Sab gated rakho par MQL score threshold kam karo
Pipeline se judge karo; TOFU ungate, high-intent offers gated
Content banana band karo aur budget cold calling mein daalo
mr: MQLs आणखी 80% वाढवण्यासाठी आणखी content gate करा
सगळे gated ठेवा पण MQL score threshold कमी करा
Pipeline वरून मोजा; TOFU ungate, high-intent offers gated ठेवा
Content बनवणे बंद करून budget cold calling कडे वळवा

exp.en: Form fills on educational content signal curiosity, not buying intent, so MQL volume became a vanity metric. Open TOFU content to build reach and trust, and capture leads on high-intent offers (demo, pricing, ROI calculator) measured by SQLs and pipeline.
exp.hi: Educational content par form fills curiosity dikhate hain, buying intent nahi, isliye MQL volume vanity metric ban gaya. TOFU content open karo taaki reach aur trust bane, aur high-intent offers (demo, pricing, ROI calculator) par leads lo, jinhe SQLs aur pipeline se measure karo.
exp.mr: Educational content वरील form fills उत्सुकता दाखवतात, खरेदीची इच्छा नाही, म्हणून MQL संख्या vanity metric झाली. पोहोच आणि विश्वास वाढवण्यासाठी TOFU content खुले करा, आणि high-intent offers (demo, pricing, ROI calculator) वर leads घ्या, ज्यांचे मोजमाप SQLs आणि pipeline ने करा.

q.en: A D2C apparel brand finds 70% of orders use coupons, and full-price sales crash between sales. Customers now wait for discounts. Best long-term fix?
q.hi: Ek D2C apparel brand mein 70% orders coupons se hote hain, aur sales ke beech full-price sales gir jaati hai. Customers ab discount ka wait karte hain. Best long-term fix?
q.mr: एका D2C apparel brand मध्ये 70% orders coupons वापरून होतात, आणि sales दरम्यान full-price विक्री कोसळते. ग्राहक आता सवलतीची वाट पाहतात. सर्वोत्तम दीर्घकालीन उपाय?

en: Taper blanket discounts, add value perks, and test who needs offers
Run a bigger sale every week so customers never have to wait
Stop all discounts overnight and remove the coupon field forever
Offer discounts only to first-time buyers via paid ads
hi: Blanket discounts dheere kam karo, value perks do, test karo kise offer chahiye
Har hafte bada sale chalao taaki customers ko wait na karna pade
Raaton-raat saare discounts band karo aur coupon field hata do
Discounts sirf paid ads se first-time buyers ko do
mr: सरसकट सवलती हळूहळू कमी करा, value perks द्या, कोणाला offer लागते ते test करा
दर आठवड्याला मोठा sale चालवा म्हणजे ग्राहकांना थांबावे लागणार नाही
रातोरात सर्व सवलती बंद करा आणि coupon field काढून टाका
सवलती फक्त paid ads द्वारे first-time खरेदीदारांना द्या

exp.en: Constant discounts train customers to wait and erode margin. Gradually reducing blanket offers, replacing them with non-price value, and using holdout tests to find who buys anyway protects both revenue and brand. Stopping overnight risks a sharp sales drop.
exp.hi: Lagataar discounts customers ko wait karna sikhate hain aur margin khaate hain. Blanket offers dheere kam karna, unki jagah non-price value dena, aur holdout tests se pata karna ki kaun bina discount bhi khareedta hai, revenue aur brand dono bachata hai. Raaton-raat band karne se sales achanak gir sakti hai.
exp.mr: सततच्या सवलती ग्राहकांना वाट पाहायला शिकवतात आणि margin खातात. सरसकट offers हळूहळू कमी करणे, त्याऐवजी किमतीव्यतिरिक्त value देणे आणि holdout tests ने कोण सवलतीशिवायही खरेदी करतो ते शोधणे revenue आणि brand दोन्ही वाचवते. रातोरात बंद केल्यास विक्री अचानक घसरू शकते.

q.en: An edtech firm wants to load 3 lakh leads collected 4 years ago (for a different course) into its new email and WhatsApp automation and blast them all. Your advice?
q.hi: Ek edtech firm 4 saal pehle (alag course ke liye) collect hue 3 lakh leads ko naye email aur WhatsApp automation mein daalkar sabko blast karna chahti hai. Aapki advice?
q.mr: एका edtech firm ला 4 वर्षांपूर्वी (वेगळ्या course साठी) गोळा केलेल्या 3 लाख leads नवीन email आणि WhatsApp automation मध्ये टाकून सर्वांना blast करायचे आहे. तुमचा सल्ला?

en: Go ahead: leads once collected can be used for any purpose
Don't blast: consent was for another purpose; validate and re-permission
Send only WhatsApp, since consent rules apply just to email
Upload the list to a new ESP account to protect the old one's reputation
hi: Aage badho: ek baar mile leads kisi bhi purpose ke liye use ho sakte hain
Blast mat karo: consent alag purpose ka tha; validate karke fresh opt-in lo
Sirf WhatsApp bhejo, consent rules sirf email par lagte hain
Purane account ki reputation bachane ke liye list naye ESP par upload karo
mr: पुढे जा: एकदा मिळालेल्या leads कोणत्याही कारणासाठी वापरता येतात
Blast करू नका: संमती वेगळ्या कारणासाठी होती; validate करून नवीन opt-in घ्या
फक्त WhatsApp पाठवा, संमतीचे नियम फक्त email ला लागू होतात
जुन्या account ची reputation वाचवण्यासाठी list नवीन ESP वर upload करा

exp.en: Consent tied to a specific purpose is a core principle of India's DPDP Act, 2023, and WhatsApp also requires opt-in. Four-year-old data is full of dead addresses and possible spam traps, so a blast would wreck deliverability. Validate and run a permission campaign first.
exp.hi: Specific purpose se judi consent India ke DPDP Act, 2023 ka core principle hai, aur WhatsApp bhi opt-in maangta hai. 4 saal purane data mein dead addresses aur spam traps ho sakte hain, blast se deliverability barbaad hogi. Pehle validate karo aur permission campaign chalao.
exp.mr: विशिष्ट कारणाशी जोडलेली संमती हे भारताच्या DPDP Act, 2023 चे मूलभूत तत्त्व आहे, आणि WhatsApp सुद्धा opt-in मागते. 4 वर्षे जुन्या data मध्ये बंद addresses आणि spam traps असू शकतात, त्यामुळे blast केल्यास deliverability बिघडेल. आधी validate करून permission campaign चालवा.

q.en: A premium packaged-foods company wants to launch a low-price range for Tier-3 towns, but fears it will cheapen the premium master brand. What's the best brand-architecture choice?
q.hi: Ek premium packaged-foods company Tier-3 towns ke liye low-price range launch karna chahti hai, par darr hai ki premium master brand sasta dikhega. Best brand-architecture choice kya hai?
q.mr: एका premium packaged-foods company ला Tier-3 शहरांसाठी कमी किमतीची range launch करायची आहे, पण premium master brand स्वस्त वाटेल अशी भीती आहे. सर्वोत्तम brand-architecture निवड कोणती?

en: Put the master brand name prominently on the budget packs
Lower the price of the premium range to match
Skip packaging and sell the budget range loose
Launch it as a separate or lightly endorsed brand with its own positioning
hi: Budget packs par master brand ka naam bada karke lagao
Premium range ka price bhi utna hi kam karo
Packaging chhodo aur budget range loose becho
Ise alag ya lightly endorsed brand ki tarah, apni positioning ke saath launch karo
mr: Budget packs वर master brand चे नाव ठळकपणे लावा
Premium range ची किंमतही तितकीच कमी करा
Packaging टाळून budget range सुटी विका
याला वेगळा किंवा हलक्या endorsement चा brand म्हणून स्वतःच्या positioning सह launch करा

exp.en: A separate brand (house-of-brands) or a light endorsement lets the company reach a new price segment without diluting the parent's premium meaning. Putting the master brand front-and-centre on budget packs risks exactly the dilution they fear.
exp.hi: Alag brand (house-of-brands) ya light endorsement se company naya price segment pakad sakti hai bina parent ki premium image dilute kiye. Budget packs par master brand ko aage rakhna wahi dilution laata hai jiska darr hai.
exp.mr: वेगळा brand (house-of-brands) किंवा हलके endorsement वापरल्यास company parent ची premium ओळख कमी न करता नवीन किंमत गटापर्यंत पोहोचू शकते. Budget packs वर master brand ठळक ठेवल्यास नेमका तोच धोका निर्माण होतो.

q.en: You A/B test two subject lines on a list of 2,000 subscribers; B gets 3 more clicks than A. What's the main pitfall in declaring B the winner?
q.hi: Aap 2,000 subscribers ki list par do subject lines A/B test karte ho; B ko A se 3 clicks zyada milte hain. B ko winner declare karne mein main pitfall kya hai?
q.mr: तुम्ही 2,000 subscribers च्या list वर दोन subject lines चा A/B test करता; B ला A पेक्षा 3 clicks जास्त मिळतात. B ला विजेता घोषित करण्यातील मुख्य धोका कोणता?

en: Subject lines can't be A/B tested, only email bodies
Click data is never used to judge subject lines
The sample is too small; a 3-click gap is likely random noise
B should lose because it is the newer version
hi: Subject lines A/B test nahi ho sakti, sirf email body
Subject lines judge karne ke liye click data kabhi use nahi hota
Sample bahut chhota hai; 3 clicks ka farak shayad random noise hai
B ko haarna chahiye kyunki woh naya version hai
mr: Subject lines चा A/B test होऊ शकत नाही, फक्त email body चा
Subject lines तपासण्यासाठी click data कधीच वापरत नाहीत
Sample खूप लहान आहे; 3 clicks चा फरक बहुधा योगायोग आहे
B हरायला हवा कारण तो नवीन version आहे

exp.en: With ~1,000 people per variant, a difference of a few clicks is well within random variation, so it isn't statistically significant. Test bolder differences, pool results over several sends, or use a larger list before trusting a winner.
exp.hi: Har variant mein ~1,000 log hon toh kuch clicks ka farak random variation ke andar hai, statistically significant nahi. Bade differences test karo, kai sends ke results jodo, ya badi list use karo, tabhi winner par bharosa karo.
exp.mr: प्रत्येक variant मध्ये ~1,000 लोक असताना काही clicks चा फरक random चढउताराच्या आतच असतो, statistically significant नाही. मोठे फरक test करा, अनेक sends चे निकाल एकत्र करा किंवा मोठी list वापरा, मगच विजेत्यावर विश्वास ठेवा.

q.en: Overnight, a Pune restaurant gets 15 one-star Google reviews from accounts with no history that clearly never visited. What's the best course of action?
q.hi: Ek raat mein Pune ke ek restaurant ko 15 one-star Google reviews mile, aise accounts se jinki koi history nahi aur jo clearly kabhi aaye hi nahi. Best course of action kya hai?
q.mr: एका रात्रीत Pune मधील एका restaurant ला कोणताही इतिहास नसलेल्या, स्पष्टपणे कधीही न आलेल्या accounts कडून 15 one-star Google reviews मिळाले. सर्वोत्तम कृती कोणती?

en: Report them to Google, keep evidence, reply calmly, keep earning real reviews
Buy 50 five-star reviews online to balance the rating quickly
Reply to each review publicly accusing a named competitor
Delete the Google Business Profile and create a fresh one
hi: Google ko report karo, evidence rakho, calmly reply karo, real reviews lete raho
Rating jaldi balance karne ke liye online 50 five-star reviews khareedo
Har review par publicly kisi competitor ka naam lekar ilzaam lagao
Google Business Profile delete karke ek naya banao
mr: Google कडे report करा, पुरावे ठेवा, शांत reply करा, खरे reviews मिळवत राहा
Rating लवकर सावरण्यासाठी online 50 five-star reviews विकत घ्या
प्रत्येक review वर जाहीरपणे एखाद्या स्पर्धकाचे नाव घेऊन आरोप करा
Google Business Profile delete करून नवीन तयार करा

exp.en: Fake-review attacks can be flagged to Google for removal; keeping screenshots and dates helps an appeal. Short, factual replies reassure readers, while buying reviews or naming rivals without proof creates new policy and legal risks. Deleting the profile loses all genuine reviews too.
exp.hi: Fake-review attacks ko removal ke liye Google ko flag kar sakte ho; screenshots aur dates rakhne se appeal mein madad milti hai. Chhote, factual replies readers ko assure karte hain, jabki reviews khareedna ya bina proof competitor ka naam lena naye policy aur legal risks laata hai. Profile delete karne se genuine reviews bhi chale jaate hain.
exp.mr: Fake-review हल्ले काढण्यासाठी Google कडे flag करता येतात; screenshots आणि तारखा ठेवल्यास appeal ला मदत होते. छोटे, तथ्यात्मक replies वाचकांना आश्वस्त करतात, तर reviews विकत घेणे किंवा पुराव्याशिवाय स्पर्धकाचे नाव घेणे नवीन policy आणि कायदेशीर धोके निर्माण करते. Profile delete केल्यास खरे reviews सुद्धा जातात.

q.en: A B2B brand's organic traffic is stable, but organic leads fell 40%. Traffic now goes mostly to how-to posts with no CTAs, while older comparison and pricing pages slipped in rankings. Best plan?
q.hi: Ek B2B brand ka organic traffic stable hai, par organic leads 40% gir gaye. Traffic ab zyada bina CTA wale how-to posts par jaata hai, aur purane comparison aur pricing pages ki ranking gir gayi. Best plan?
q.mr: एका B2B brand चे organic traffic स्थिर आहे, पण organic leads 40% घसरल्या. Traffic आता मुख्यतः CTA नसलेल्या how-to posts वर जाते, तर जुन्या comparison आणि pricing pages ची ranking घसरली. सर्वोत्तम योजना?

en: Publish more how-to posts, since they already get the traffic
Refresh decayed high-intent pages; add CTAs and links from how-to posts
Delete all how-to posts so traffic flows to pricing pages
Replace all organic effort with paid search campaigns
hi: Aur how-to posts publish karo, traffic toh unhi par hai
Decay hue high-intent pages refresh karo; how-to posts mein CTAs aur links jodo
Saare how-to posts delete karo taaki traffic pricing pages par jaaye
Saara organic effort paid search campaigns se replace karo
mr: आणखी how-to posts publish करा, traffic तर तिथेच आहे
घसरलेली high-intent pages refresh करा; how-to posts मध्ये CTAs व links जोडा
Traffic pricing pages कडे जावे म्हणून सर्व how-to posts delete करा
सर्व organic प्रयत्न paid search campaigns ने बदला

exp.en: Leads fell because high-intent pages decayed and informational traffic has no path to convert. Updating comparison/pricing pages recovers buyer-intent rankings, and contextual CTAs or lead magnets plus internal links turn how-to readers into leads. Deleting useful posts would throw away traffic.
exp.hi: Leads isliye gire kyunki high-intent pages decay ho gaye aur informational traffic ke paas convert hone ka raasta nahi. Comparison/pricing pages update karne se buyer-intent rankings wapas aati hain, aur contextual CTAs ya lead magnets plus internal links how-to readers ko leads banate hain. Useful posts delete karna traffic phenkna hai.
exp.mr: Leads घसरल्या कारण high-intent pages मागे पडली आणि माहितीपर traffic ला convert होण्याचा मार्गच नाही. Comparison/pricing pages update केल्याने buyer-intent rankings परत येतात, आणि contextual CTAs किंवा lead magnets सह internal links how-to वाचकांना leads बनवतात. उपयुक्त posts delete करणे म्हणजे traffic वाया घालवणे.
